  function line(a,b,color,width=1.5,context=ctx2){if(!a||!b)return;context.strokeStyle=color;context.lineWidth=width;context.beginPath();context.moveTo(a.x,a.y);context.lineTo(b.x,b.y);context.stroke();}
  function boneLines(b){
    if(b.cs2Agent)syncBotPose(b);
    let bones=bonesOf(b.cs2Agent);if(!Object.keys(bones).length&&b.mesh?.traverse){bones={};b.mesh.traverse(o=>{if(o.isBone)bones[o.name]=o;});}
    const entries=Object.entries(bones),main=entries.filter(([name])=>/^(?:head|neck|spine|pelvis|clavicle|arm_upper|arm_lower|hand|leg_upper|leg_lower|ankle)(?:_|$)/i.test(name)),values=(main.length>=5?main:entries.slice(0,64)).map(([,bone])=>bone),set=new Set(values),out=[];
    for(const bone of values){let parent=bone.parent;while(parent&&!set.has(parent))parent=parent.parent;if(!parent)continue;bone.updateWorldMatrix?.(true,false);parent.updateWorldMatrix?.(true,false);const a=bone.getWorldPosition(vec()),p=parent.getWorldPosition(vec());if(plausiblePoint(b,a)&&plausiblePoint(b,p))out.push([a,p]);}
    if(out.length)return{lines:out,estimated:false};
    // Older/procedural offline bodies have no skeleton: show a dashed body guide.
    const x=b.x,z=b.z,y=bodyY(b),h=finite(b.height,1.8288),right=vec(Math.cos(b.yaw||0),0,-Math.sin(b.yaw||0));
    const at=(height,side=0)=>vec(x,y+h*height,z).addScaledVector(right,side);
    const head=at(.92),neck=at(.79),pelvis=at(.43),lShoulder=at(.74,-.25),rShoulder=at(.74,.25),lElbow=at(.57,-.32),rElbow=at(.57,.32),lHand=at(.42,-.3),rHand=at(.42,.3),lKnee=at(.22,-.13),rKnee=at(.22,.13),lFoot=at(.02,-.15),rFoot=at(.02,.15);
    return{estimated:true,lines:[[head,neck],[neck,pelvis],[neck,lShoulder],[neck,rShoulder],[lShoulder,lElbow],[lElbow,lHand],[rShoulder,rElbow],[rElbow,rHand],[pelvis,lKnee],[lKnee,lFoot],[pelvis,rKnee],[rKnee,rFoot]]};
  }
  function drawSkeleton(b,color){const data=boneLines(b);ctx2.save();if(data.estimated)ctx2.setLineDash([3,3]);for(const[a,b]of data.lines){line(project(a),project(b),color,cfg.espSkeletonWidth);stats.skeletonLines++;}ctx2.restore();}
  function draw3DBox(b,color){const r=finite(b.radius,.4064),y=bodyY(b),h=finite(b.height,1.8288),points=[];for(const dy of[0,h])for(const dz of[-r,r])for(const dx of[-r,r])points.push(project(vec(b.x+dx,y+dy,b.z+dz)));for(const[a,c]of[[0,1],[1,3],[3,2],[2,0],[4,5],[5,7],[7,6],[6,4],[0,4],[1,5],[2,6],[3,7]])line(points[a],points[c],color,cfg.espBoxThickness);}
  function drawArrow(b,color){const p=g.player,angle=wrapAngle(Math.atan2(-(b.x-p.x),-(b.z-p.z))-p.yaw),dx=-Math.sin(angle),dy=-Math.cos(angle),r=Math.max(30,Math.min(innerWidth,innerHeight)*.4),x=innerWidth/2+dx*r,y=innerHeight/2+dy*r;ctx2.save();ctx2.translate(x,y);ctx2.rotate(Math.atan2(dy,dx));ctx2.fillStyle=color;ctx2.beginPath();ctx2.moveTo(12,0);ctx2.lineTo(-7,-7);ctx2.lineTo(-7,7);ctx2.closePath();ctx2.fill();ctx2.restore();}
  function drawRadar(){const x=108,y=132,r=78,p=g.player;ctx2.save();ctx2.fillStyle='rgba(10,16,25,.78)';ctx2.strokeStyle='rgba(105,182,255,.7)';ctx2.lineWidth=1;ctx2.beginPath();ctx2.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx2.fill();ctx2.stroke();line({x:x-r,y},{x:x+r,y},'rgba(255,255,255,.2)',1);line({x,y:y-r},{x,y:y+r},'rgba(255,255,255,.2)',1);ctx2.fillStyle='#fff';ctx2.fillRect(x-2,y-2,4,4);for(const e of espTargets()){const b=e.native,dx=b.x-p.x,dz=b.z-p.z,px=(dx*Math.cos(p.yaw)-dz*Math.sin(p.yaw))/cfg.espRadarRange*r,py=(dx*Math.sin(p.yaw)+dz*Math.cos(p.yaw))/cfg.espRadarRange*r;if(Math.hypot(px,py)>r-4)continue;ctx2.fillStyle=friendly(e)?cfg.espTeamColor:e===currentTarget||e===rageTarget?cfg.espTargetColor:cfg.espVisibleColor;ctx2.beginPath();ctx2.arc(x+px,y+py,3.5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx2.fill();}ctx2.fillStyle='#edf4ff';ctx2.font='11px monospace';ctx2.textAlign='center';ctx2.fillText('RADAR • '+cfg.espRadarRange+'m',x,y+r+15);ctx2.restore();}
  function box(x,y,w,h,color,context=ctx2){
    if(cfg.espOutline&&cfg.espOutlineThickness>0){context.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.9)';context.lineWidth=cfg.espBoxThickness+cfg.espOutlineThickness*2;context.strokeRect(x,y,w,h);}
    context.strokeStyle=color;context.lineWidth=cfg.espBoxThickness;
    if(cfg.espBoxStyle==='corners'){const l=Math.min(w,h)*.28;for(const[a,b,c,d]of[[x,y,x+l,y],[x,y,x,y+l],[x+w,y,x+w-l,y],[x+w,y,x+w,y+l],[x,y+h,x+l,y+h],[x,y+h,x,y+h-l],[x+w,y+h,x+w-l,y+h],[x+w,y+h,x+w,y+h-l]])line({x:a,y:b},{x:c,y:d},color,cfg.espBoxThickness,context);}else context.strokeRect(x,y,w,h);
  }
  function drawCombatHUD(){
    if(cfg.velocityHud){const p=g.player,speed=Math.hypot(p.vx,p.vz),mode=cfg.rageFly?'FLY':cfg.rageVelocityBhop?'BHOP':p.onGround?'GROUND':'AIR';ctx2.save();ctx2.textAlign='center';ctx2.font='bold 14px monospace';ctx2.lineWidth=3;ctx2.strokeStyle='#000';ctx2.fillStyle='#edf4ff';const label=speed.toFixed(1)+' m/s • '+mode;ctx2.strokeText(label,innerWidth/2,innerHeight-48);ctx2.fillText(label,innerWidth/2,innerHeight-48);ctx2.restore();}
    const now=performance.now();for(let i=damagePopups.length-1;i>=0;i--){const hit=damagePopups[i],age=(now-hit.time)/1000;if(age>1){damagePopups.splice(i,1);continue;}if(!cfg.gunDamageNumbers)continue;const point=project(hit.point.clone().add(vec(0,age*.65,0)));if(!point)continue;ctx2.save();ctx2.textAlign='center';ctx2.font='bold 17px monospace';ctx2.globalAlpha=1-age;ctx2.lineWidth=3;ctx2.strokeStyle='#000';ctx2.fillStyle=hit.head?'#ffe169':'#fff';ctx2.strokeText('-'+hit.amount,point.x,point.y);ctx2.fillText('-'+hit.amount,point.x,point.y);ctx2.restore();}
  }
  let lastOverlay=-Infinity,overlayDirty=false;
  function drawESP(){
    const enabled=isSolo()&&g.state==='playing'&&(cfg.esp||cfg.velocityHud||cfg.gunDamageNumbers||cfg.gunHitEnabled||cfg.drawFov&&cfg.aimbot);
    if(!enabled){if(overlayDirty)ctx2.clearRect(0,0,innerWidth,innerHeight);overlayDirty=false;lastOverlay=-Infinity;stats.skeletonLines=0;return;}
    const now=performance.now();if(now-lastOverlay<1000/30)return;lastOverlay=now;overlayDirty=true;stats.overlayFrames++;
    ctx2.clearRect(0,0,innerWidth,innerHeight);stats.skeletonLines=0;
    g.camera.updateMatrixWorld();
    drawCombatHUD();drawHitmarkers();
    if(cfg.drawFov&&cfg.aimbot){const radius=Math.tan(Math.min(89,cfg.fov)*Math.PI/180)/Math.tan(g.camera.fov*Math.PI/360)*innerHeight/2;ctx2.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.4)';ctx2.lineWidth=1;ctx2.beginPath();ctx2.arc(innerWidth/2,innerHeight/2,Math.min(radius,Math.hypot(innerWidth,innerHeight)),0,Math.PI*2);ctx2.stroke();}
    if(!cfg.esp)return;if(cfg.espRadar)drawRadar();
    for(const e of espTargets()){
      const b=e.native,centerW=e.center,dist=centerW.distanceTo(P.eye);if(dist>cfg.espMaxDist)continue;
      const visible=world.hasLineOfSight(P.eye,centerW);if(!visible&&!cfg.espShowOccluded)continue;
      const team=friendly(e),selected=!team&&(e===currentTarget||e===rageTarget),hex=team?cfg.espTeamColor:selected?cfg.espTargetColor:!visible&&cfg.espVisibilityColors?cfg.espOccludedColor:cfg.espVisibleColor,color=rgba(hex,cfg.espOpacity);
      const center=project(centerW);if(!center||center.x<0||center.x>innerWidth||center.y<0||center.y>innerHeight){if(cfg.espArrows)drawArrow(b,color);continue;}
      const baseY=bodyY(b),bottom=project(vec(b.x,baseY,b.z)),top=project(vec(b.x,baseY+finite(b.height,1.8288),b.z)),head=project(bonePoint(b,true));if(!bottom||!top)continue;
      const h=Math.max(12,Math.abs(bottom.y-top.y))*cfg.espBoxScale,w=Math.max(10,h*.43),x=center.x-w/2,y=(top.y+bottom.y)/2-h/2,hp=clamp(b.health/100,0,1);
      ctx2.save();ctx2.globalAlpha=cfg.espOpacity;if(cfg.espGlow){ctx2.shadowColor=color;ctx2.shadowBlur=cfg.espGlowSize;}
      if(cfg.espFill){ctx2.fillStyle=rgba(hex,cfg.espFillOpacity);ctx2.fillRect(x,y,w,h);}if(cfg.espBoxes)box(x,y,w,h,color);if(cfg.espBox3D)draw3DBox(b,color);if(cfg.espSkeleton)drawSkeleton(b,color);
      if(cfg.espHeadDot&&head){ctx2.fillStyle=color;ctx2.beginPath();ctx2.arc(head.x,head.y,cfg.espHeadDotSize,0,Math.PI*2);ctx2.fill();}
      if(cfg.espHealth){ctx2.shadowBlur=0;ctx2.fillStyle='#111';ctx2.fillRect(x-8,y-1,5,h+2);ctx2.fillStyle=hp>.6?'#45ff70':hp>.3?'#ffe14a':'#ff3d45';ctx2.fillRect(x-7,y+h*(1-hp),3,h*hp);}
      let label=team?'TEAM':'';if(cfg.espNames)label+=(label?' • ':'')+(b.name||'BOT');if(cfg.espDistance)label+=(label?' • ':'')+Math.round(dist)+'m';if(cfg.espHealthText)label+=(label?' • ':'')+Math.round(b.health)+'HP';
      if(label){ctx2.shadowBlur=0;ctx2.font='bold '+cfg.espFontSize+'px monospace';ctx2.textAlign='center';ctx2.strokeStyle='#000';ctx2.lineWidth=3;ctx2.strokeText(label,center.x,y-5);ctx2.fillStyle=team?cfg.espTeamColor:selected?cfg.espTargetColor:cfg.espTextColor;ctx2.fillText(label,center.x,y-5);}
      let extra=cfg.espWeapon?(typeof b.weapon==='string'?b.weapon:b.weapon?.name||b.weapon?.id||b.weaponId||''):'';if(cfg.espLoading&&!b.cs2Agent)extra+=(extra?' • ':'')+(b._cs2Failed?'model unavailable':'model loading');if(extra){ctx2.shadowBlur=0;ctx2.font=cfg.espFontSize+'px monospace';ctx2.textAlign='center';ctx2.strokeStyle='#000';ctx2.lineWidth=3;ctx2.strokeText(extra,center.x,y+h+14);ctx2.fillStyle=cfg.espTextColor;ctx2.fillText(extra,center.x,y+h+14);}
      if(cfg.espTracers)line({x:innerWidth/2,y:cfg.espTracerOrigin==='bottom'?innerHeight-3:innerHeight/2},{x:center.x,y:bottom.y},color,cfg.espTracerThickness);
      if(cfg.espLook&&head){const forward=vec(-Math.sin(b.yaw||0)*2,Math.sin(b.pitch||0)*2,-Math.cos(b.yaw||0)*2),end=project(bonePoint(b,true).add(forward));line(head,end,color,2);}
      ctx2.restore();
    }
  }

  // A bounded 2D illustration, drawn on demand with the live ESP style settings.
  let espPreviewOpen=false,espPreviewRoot=null,espPreviewStyle=null,espPreviewCanvas=null,espPreviewContext=null,espPreviewSignature='',espPreviewDrag=null;
  function closeEspPreview(){espPreviewOpen=false;espPreviewDrag=null;if(espPreviewRoot)espPreviewRoot.style.display='none';const button=panel.querySelector('#dlEspPreview');button.textContent='OPEN ESP PREVIEW';button.setAttribute?.('aria-expanded','false');}
  function previewText(context,text,x,y,color,size=cfg.espFontSize,bold=false){context.shadowBlur=0;context.font=(bold?'bold ':'')+size+'px monospace';context.textAlign='center';context.strokeStyle='#000';context.lineWidth=3;context.strokeText(text,x,y);context.fillStyle=color;context.fillText(text,x,y);}
  function drawEspPreviewSample(context,sample,index){
    const col=index%2,row=Math.floor(index/2),left=col*290,top=row*214,cx=left+145,bodyTop=top+58,height=116,base=bodyTop+height;
    context.save();context.fillStyle='#151e2a';context.fillRect(left+8,top+8,274,199);context.fillStyle='#96abc3';context.font='11px monospace';context.textAlign='left';context.fillText(sample.title,left+20,top+28);
    context.strokeStyle='#293b50';context.lineWidth=1;context.beginPath();context.moveTo(left+20,base+20);context.lineTo(left+270,base+20);context.stroke();
    const hex=sample.team?cfg.espTeamColor:sample.selected?cfg.espTargetColor:sample.occluded&&cfg.espVisibilityColors?cfg.espOccludedColor:cfg.espVisibleColor,color=rgba(hex,cfg.espOpacity);
    const teamAllowed=!sample.team||cfg.espTeammates,inRange=sample.distance<=cfg.espMaxDist,allowed=teamAllowed&&inRange&&(!sample.occluded||cfg.espShowOccluded);
    const head={x:cx,y:bodyTop+9},neck={x:cx,y:bodyTop+24},pelvis={x:cx,y:bodyTop+72},shoulders=[{x:cx-17,y:bodyTop+29},{x:cx+17,y:bodyTop+29}],elbows=[{x:cx-23,y:bodyTop+51},{x:cx+23,y:bodyTop+51}],hands=[{x:cx-20,y:bodyTop+70},{x:cx+20,y:bodyTop+70}],knees=[{x:cx-10,y:bodyTop+93},{x:cx+10,y:bodyTop+93}],feet=[{x:cx-12,y:base},{x:cx+12,y:base}];
    function silhouette(fill){context.save();context.fillStyle=fill;context.strokeStyle=fill;context.beginPath();context.arc(head.x,head.y,8,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.fillRect(cx-14,bodyTop+23,28,48);context.lineWidth=9;context.lineCap='round';for(let side=0;side<2;side++){context.beginPath();context.moveTo(shoulders[side].x,shoulders[side].y);context.lineTo(elbows[side].x,elbows[side].y);context.lineTo(hands[side].x,hands[side].y);context.stroke();context.beginPath();context.moveTo(cx+(side?8:-8),pelvis.y);context.lineTo(knees[side].x,knees[side].y);context.lineTo(feet[side].x,feet[side].y);context.stroke();}context.restore();}
    const cham=cfg.espChams&&teamAllowed&&(!sample.occluded||cfg.espChamsThrough);silhouette(cham&&!sample.occluded?rgba(hex,.65):'#425365');
    if(sample.occluded){context.fillStyle='rgba(35,47,63,.94)';context.fillRect(cx-38,bodyTop+34,76,51);context.fillStyle='#71839a';context.font='9px monospace';context.textAlign='center';context.fillText('WALL',cx,bodyTop+62);if(cham&&cfg.espChamsThrough)silhouette(rgba(hex,.65));}
    if(!allowed){context.fillStyle='#8796aa';context.font='10px monospace';context.textAlign='center';context.fillText(!teamAllowed?'Teammate ESP off':!inRange?'Outside max distance':'Hidden enemies filtered',cx,top+200);context.restore();return;}
    const h=height*cfg.espBoxScale,w=Math.max(10,h*.43),x=cx-w/2,y=bodyTop+(height-h)/2,hp=sample.health/100;
    context.save();context.globalAlpha=cfg.espOpacity;if(cfg.espGlow){context.shadowColor=color;context.shadowBlur=cfg.espGlowSize;}
    if(cfg.espFill){context.fillStyle=rgba(hex,cfg.espFillOpacity);context.fillRect(x,y,w,h);}if(cfg.espBoxes)box(x,y,w,h,color,context);
    if(cfg.espBox3D){const a=[{x:cx-25,y:bodyTop},{x:cx+25,y:bodyTop},{x:cx+25,y:base},{x:cx-25,y:base}],b=a.map(p=>({x:p.x+10,y:p.y-8}));for(let n=0;n<4;n++){line(a[n],a[(n+1)%4],color,cfg.espBoxThickness,context);line(b[n],b[(n+1)%4],color,cfg.espBoxThickness,context);line(a[n],b[n],color,cfg.espBoxThickness,context);}}
    if(cfg.espSkeleton){line(head,neck,color,cfg.espSkeletonWidth,context);line(neck,pelvis,color,cfg.espSkeletonWidth,context);for(let side=0;side<2;side++)for(const[a,b]of[[neck,shoulders[side]],[shoulders[side],elbows[side]],[elbows[side],hands[side]],[pelvis,knees[side]],[knees[side],feet[side]]])line(a,b,color,cfg.espSkeletonWidth,context);}
    if(cfg.espHeadDot){context.fillStyle=color;context.beginPath();context.arc(head.x,head.y,cfg.espHeadDotSize,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();}
    if(cfg.espHealth){context.shadowBlur=0;context.fillStyle='#111';context.fillRect(x-8,y-1,5,h+2);context.fillStyle=hp>.6?'#45ff70':hp>.3?'#ffe14a':'#ff3d45';context.fillRect(x-7,y+h*(1-hp),3,h*hp);}
    let label=sample.team?'TEAM':'';if(cfg.espNames)label+=(label?' • ':'')+sample.name;if(cfg.espDistance)label+=(label?' • ':'')+sample.distance+'m';if(cfg.espHealthText)label+=(label?' • ':'')+sample.health+'HP';if(label)previewText(context,label,cx,y-5,sample.team?cfg.espTeamColor:sample.selected?cfg.espTargetColor:cfg.espTextColor,cfg.espFontSize,true);
    let extra=cfg.espWeapon?sample.weapon:'';if(cfg.espLoading&&sample.loading)extra+=(extra?' • ':'')+'model loading';if(extra)previewText(context,extra,cx,y+h+14,cfg.espTextColor);
    if(cfg.espTracers)line({x:cx,y:cfg.espTracerOrigin==='bottom'?top+204:top+107},{x:cx,y:base},color,cfg.espTracerThickness,context);
    if(cfg.espLook)line(head,{x:head.x+31,y:head.y-14},color,2,context);
    context.restore();context.restore();
  }
  function refreshEspPreview(force=false){
    if(!espPreviewOpen||stopped)return;if(!cfg.open||codeLabOpen){closeEspPreview();return;}
    const signature=JSON.stringify(Object.entries(cfg).filter(([key])=>key.startsWith('esp')||key.startsWith('theme')));if(!force&&signature===espPreviewSignature)return;espPreviewSignature=signature;
    for(const[key,value]of Object.entries({bg:cfg.themeBg,header:cfg.themeHeader,text:cfg.themeText,accent:cfg.themeAccent,border:cfg.themeBorder}))espPreviewRoot.style.setProperty('--ep-'+key,value);
    espPreviewRoot.querySelector('#dlEspPreviewStatus').textContent=cfg.esp?'Live settings • preview samples':'ESP is OFF • preview only; enable ESP to use it in the match';
    const c=espPreviewContext;c.clearRect(0,0,580,428);c.fillStyle='#101723';c.fillRect(0,0,580,428);
    const samples=[{title:'VISIBLE ENEMY',name:'ENEMY',distance:12,health:76,weapon:'AK-47'},{title:'HIDDEN ENEMY',name:'ENEMY',distance:18,health:38,weapon:'AWP',occluded:true,loading:true},{title:'TARGETED ENEMY',name:'TARGET',distance:24,health:100,weapon:'M4A4',selected:true},{title:'TEAMMATE',name:'ALLY',distance:10,health:52,weapon:'M4A1-S',team:true}];samples.forEach((sample,index)=>drawEspPreviewSample(c,sample,index));
    if(cfg.espArrows){c.save();c.globalAlpha=cfg.espOpacity;c.fillStyle=rgba(cfg.espVisibleColor,cfg.espOpacity);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(577,207);c.lineTo(566,199);c.lineTo(566,215);c.closePath();c.fill();c.restore();}
    if(cfg.espRadar){const x=290,y=214,r=31;c.save();c.fillStyle='rgba(10,16,25,.9)';c.strokeStyle='rgba(105,182,255,.7)';c.lineWidth=1;c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.stroke();line({x:x-r,y},{x:x+r,y},'rgba(255,255,255,.2)',1,c);line({x,y:y-r},{x,y:y+r},'rgba(255,255,255,.2)',1,c);c.fillStyle='#fff';c.fillRect(x-2,y-2,4,4);for(const sample of samples){if(sample.team&&!cfg.espTeammates||sample.distance>cfg.espRadarRange)continue;const i=samples.indexOf(sample),angle=i*1.5,d=Math.min(r-4,sample.distance/cfg.espRadarRange*r);c.fillStyle=sample.team?cfg.espTeamColor:sample.selected?cfg.espTargetColor:cfg.espVisibleColor;c.beginPath();c.arc(x+Math.cos(angle)*d,y+Math.sin(angle)*d,2.5,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();}c.font='9px monospace';c.textAlign='center';c.fillStyle='#edf4ff';c.fillText(cfg.espRadarRange+'m',x,y+r+10);c.restore();}
  }
  function openEspPreview(){
    if(stopped)return;if(!espPreviewRoot){

Adjust ESP controls to update. Mock pose / bounds; real bones and chams depend on the game model.</div>';
      espPreviewStyle=document.createElement('style');espPreviewStyle.textContent='#doodleESPPreview{position:fixed;left:18px;top:70px;width:min(580px,calc(100vw - 36px));max-height:calc(100vh - 88px);overflow:auto;z-index:2147483646;background:var(--ep-bg,#10141c);color:var(--ep-text,#edf4ff);border:1px solid var(--ep-border,#40536b);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 12px 42px #0007;font:12px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace}#doodleESPPreview *{box-sizing:border-box}#doodleESPPreview .ep-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--ep-header,#1b2230);cursor:move;touch-action:none}#doodleESPPreview small{font-weight:400;color:var(--ep-accent,#69b6ff)}#doodleESPPreview button{background:var(--ep-header,#1b2230);color:var(--ep-text,#edf4ff);border:1px solid var(--ep-border,#40536b);border-radius:5px;padding:3px 8px;cursor:pointer}#doodleESPPreview canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}#doodleESPPreview #dlEspPreviewStatus{padding:8px 12px;color:var(--ep-accent,#69b6ff);font-size:11px}#doodleESPPreview .ep-note{padding:8px 12px;opacity:.75;font-size:10px}@media(max-width:1020px){#doodleESPPreview{top:24px;max-height:calc(100vh - 48px)}}';

      espPreviewRoot.querySelector('#dlEspPreviewClose').onclick=closeEspPreview;

      const header=espPreviewRoot.querySelector('.ep-head');listen(header,'pointerdown',event=>{if(event.button!==0||event.target?.tagName==='BUTTON')return;event.preventDefault();const rect=espPreviewRoot.getBoundingClientRect();espPreviewDrag={id:event.pointerId,x:event.clientX-rect.left,y:event.clientY-rect.top};header.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId);});

      const stopDrag=()=>{espPreviewDrag=null;};for(const type of['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])listen(header,type,stopDrag);listen(window,'blur',stopDrag);
      listen(window,'resize',()=>{if(!espPreviewOpen)return;const rect=espPreviewRoot.getBoundingClientRect();espPreviewRoot.style.left=clamp(rect.left,0,Math.max(0,innerWidth-rect.width))+'px';espPreviewRoot.style.top=clamp(rect.top,0,Math.max(0,innerHeight-rect.height))+'px';});
    }
    showPanel(true);espPreviewOpen=true;espPreviewRoot.style.display='block';const button=panel.querySelector('#dlEspPreview');button.textContent='CLOSE ESP PREVIEW';button.setAttribute?.('aria-expanded','true');refreshEspPreview(true);
  }

  cleanups.push(()=>{closeEspPreview();espPreviewRoot?.remove();espPreviewStyle?.remove();espPreviewRoot=null;espPreviewStyle=null;espPreviewCanvas=null;espPreviewContext=null;});

  let firstShot={weapon:null,id:null,target:null,since:0,fired:false,waiting:false,scope:false};
  function resetFirstShot(){firstShot={weapon:null,id:null,target:null,since:0,fired:false,waiting:false,scope:false};}
  function firstShotAllowed(w,target,aligned,demand,rage=false){
    const enabled=cfg.aimFirstShotDelay>0||cfg.aimSniperScope;
    if(!enabled||!gun(w.def())||w.state().ammo<=0||!activeCombat()||!demand||!target||rage&&!cfg.aimDelayRage){resetFirstShot();return true;}
    const sniper=w.def()?.class==='sniper',scope=!!g.scoped,entity=target.native||target;

    if(w.charging&&firstShot.since!==null&&!firstShot.waiting)return true;
    const ready=aligned&&(!sniper||!cfg.aimSniperScope||scope)&&!w.reloading&&finite(w.drawT)<=0&&!w.charging&&g.time>=finite(w.nextFire);
    if(firstShot.fired){if(!sniper||!cfg.aimDelayEachSniper)return true;if(!ready){firstShot.waiting=true;return false;}firstShot.fired=false;firstShot.since=null;}
    if(!ready){firstShot.since=null;firstShot.waiting=true;return false;}
    if(firstShot.since===null)firstShot.since=performance.now();
    firstShot.waiting=performance.now()-firstShot.since<cfg.aimFirstShotDelay;
    return !firstShot.waiting;
  }
  function noteAimShot(w,before){if(activeCombat()&&gun(w.def())&&w.lastShotT!==before)lastAimedShot={weapon:w,id:w.current,time:performance.now()};if(firstShot.weapon===w&&w.lastShotT!==before){firstShot.fired=true;firstShot.waiting=false;}}

  // Input bindings are owned by this installation and never alter native key maps.
  const bindingDefs={noclip:{button:'dlBindNoclip',key:'playerNoclipKey',label:'playerNoclipKeyLabel'},teleport:{button:'dlBindTeleport',key:'playerTeleportKey',label:'playerTeleportKeyLabel'},aim:{button:'dlBindAimHold',key:'aimHoldKey',label:'aimHoldKeyLabel'}};
  const bindingButtons=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(bindingDefs).map(([id,def])=>[id,panel.querySelector('#'+def.button)]));
  function menuKeyConflicts(code){return Object.values(bindingDefs).some(def=>cfg[def.key]===code);}
  function clearFeatureKeys(){featureKeys.clear();}
  function aimHoldActive(){return cfg.aimMode!=='hold'||featureKeys.has(cfg.aimHoldKey);}
  function keyName(code,key){return({AltLeft:'LEFT ALT',AltRight:'RIGHT ALT',ShiftLeft:'LEFT SHIFT',ShiftRight:'RIGHT SHIFT',ControlLeft:'LEFT CTRL',ControlRight:'RIGHT CTRL',MetaLeft:'LEFT META',MetaRight:'RIGHT META'})[code]||prettyKey(code,key);}
  let bindingSignature='';
  function refreshFeatureBindings(){
    const signature=[cfg.menuKey,...Object.values(bindingDefs).map(def=>cfg[def.key])].join('|');
    if(signature!==bindingSignature){const used=new Set([cfg.menuKey]);for(const def of Object.values(bindingDefs)){if(used.has(cfg[def.key])){cfg[def.key]=[defaults[def.key],'KeyV','KeyY','KeyH','KeyJ','KeyK','AltLeft','AltRight'].find(code=>!used.has(code));cfg[def.label]=keyName(cfg[def.key]);save();}used.add(cfg[def.key]);}bindingSignature=[...used].join('|');}
    for(const[id,def]of Object.entries(bindingDefs)){const button=bindingButtons[id],text=featureBinding===id?'PRESS A KEY…':cfg[def.label]||keyName(cfg[def.key]);if(button.textContent!==text)button.textContent=text;}}
  function handleFeatureBinding(event){
    if(!featureBinding)return false;event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();event.stopImmediatePropagation?.();if(event.repeat)return true;
    if(event.code==='Escape'){featureBinding=null;clearFeatureKeys();refreshFeatureBindings();toast('Key binding cancelled.');return true;}
    const code=event.code||event.key,def=bindingDefs[featureBinding];
    if(!/^(Key[A-Z]|Digit\d|F([1-9]|1[0-2])|Backquote|Space|Enter|Tab|CapsLock|Arrow(Up|Down|Left|Right)|Bracket(Left|Right)|Semicolon|Quote|Comma|Period|Slash|Backslash|Minus|Equal|Home|End|PageUp|PageDown|Insert|Delete|Numpad\w+|(?:Shift|Control|Alt|Meta)(?:Left|Right))$/.test(code)){toast('Choose a keyboard key.');return true;}
    if(code===cfg.menuKey||Object.entries(bindingDefs).some(([id,b])=>id!==featureBinding&&cfg[b.key]===code)){toast('That key already controls the menu or another mod action.');return true;}
    cfg[def.key]=code;cfg[def.label]=keyName(code,event.key);featureBinding=null;clearFeatureKeys();refreshFeatureBindings();save();toast('Bound: '+cfg[def.label]);return true;
  }
  for(const[id,def]of Object.entries(bindingDefs))listen(panel.querySelector('#'+def.button),'click',event=>{event.preventDefault();bindingMenuKey=false;refreshMenuKeyUI();featureBinding=id;clearFeatureKeys();refreshFeatureBindings();toast('Press a key; Esc cancels.');});
  listen(panel.querySelector('#dlBindMenuKey'),'click',()=>{featureBinding=null;clearFeatureKeys();refreshFeatureBindings();});
  const editing=target=>!!target&&(target.isContentEditable||['INPUT','TEXTAREA','SELECT'].includes(target.tagName));
  function consumeKey(event){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();event.stopImmediatePropagation?.();}
  listen(window,'keydown',event=>{
    if(featureBinding||bindingMenuKey||cfg.open||editing(event.target)||!activeCombat())return;
    const code=event.code||event.key;if(![cfg.playerNoclipKey,cfg.playerTeleportKey,cfg.aimHoldKey].includes(code))return;
    featureKeys.add(code);
    if(code===cfg.playerNoclipKey){consumeKey(event);if(!event.repeat){cfg.playerNoclip=!cfg.playerNoclip;syncNoclipState();syncControl(panel.querySelector('[data-k="playerNoclip"]'));save();toast('Noclip '+(cfg.playerNoclip?'ON':'OFF'));}}

  },{capture:true});

  // Clearance tests run on teleport/exit, not on every noclip movement frame.
  function clearPlayerPosition(p,x,y,z){
    if(![x,y,z].every(Number.isFinite))return false;
    const physics=g.physics,height=finite(p.height,1.8288),r=finite(p.radius,.4064)+.03;
    for(const level of [.08,height*.5,height-.04])for(const[dx,dz]of[[0,0],[r,0],[-r,0],[0,r],[0,-r]])if(physics.pointSolid?.(x+dx,y+level,z+dz))return false;
    const above=physics.raycast?.(x,y+.06,z,0,1,0,height-.1);if(above&&above.t<height-.1)return false;
    for(const[dx,dz]of[[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const hit=physics.raycast?.(x,y+height*.5,z,dx,0,dz,r);if(hit&&hit.t<r)return false;}
    return true;
  }
  let noclipState=null;
  function finishNoclip(){
    const state=noclipState;if(!state)return;noclipState=null;const p=state.player;
    if(g.player===p&&state.scene===g.scene&&(!clearPlayerPosition(p,p.x,p.y,p.z)||p.y<finite(g.map?.voidY,-3)+.1))Object.assign(p,state.entry);
    p.vx=p.vy=p.vz=0;p.onLadder=false;p.jumpBuffer=0;
  }
  function syncNoclipState(){
    const wanted=!stopped&&isSolo()&&cfg.playerNoclip&&g.state==='playing'&&g.player.alive;
    if(noclipState&&(!wanted||noclipState.player!==g.player||noclipState.scene!==g.scene))finishNoclip();
    if(wanted&&!noclipState)noclipState={player:g.player,scene:g.scene,entry:{x:g.player.x,y:g.player.y,z:g.player.z}};
  }
  function updateNoclip(p,dt,inp){
    syncNoclipState();dt=clamp(finite(dt),0,.1);const active=activeCombat();
    if(active){const mouse=inp.consumeMouse?.()||{dx:0,dy:0};let sensitivity=finite(g.sensitivity,.001);
      if(g.scoped){let horizontal=2*Math.atan(Math.tan(g.camera.fov*Math.PI/360)*4/3)*180/Math.PI;const round=Math.round(horizontal);if(Math.abs(horizontal-round)<.25)horizontal=round;sensitivity*=horizontal/90*finite(g.zoomSensRatio,1);}
      p.yaw-=finite(mouse.dx)*sensitivity;p.pitch=clamp(p.pitch-finite(mouse.dy)*sensitivity,-Math.PI/2+.01,Math.PI/2-.01);
    }
    const down=a=>active&&!!inp.downA?.(a),forward=Number(down('forward'))-Number(down('back')),right=Number(down('right'))-Number(down('left')),up=Number(down('jump'))-Number(down('crouch'));
    const direction=P.forward.multiplyScalar(forward).add(vec(Math.cos(p.yaw)*right,up,-Math.sin(p.yaw)*right));if(direction.length()>1)direction.normalize();direction.multiplyScalar(cfg.playerNoclipSpeed*(down('walk')?.35:1));
    p.vx=direction.x;p.vy=direction.y;p.vz=direction.z;p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.z+=p.vz*dt;p.onGround=false;p.onLadder=false;p.jumpBuffer=0;p.stamina=0;p.crouching=false;p.walking=down('walk');
    p.height=1.8288;p.eyeH=finite(p.eyeH,1.6256)+(1.6256-finite(p.eyeH,1.6256))*(1-Math.exp(-dt*18));p._eyeVel=0;p._stepLift=p._stepHold=0;p.tagFactor=Math.min(1,finite(p.tagFactor,1)+dt*1.4);p.spawnProt=Math.max(0,finite(p.spawnProt)-dt);
    if(active&&wantsAim()){const target=chooseTarget();if(target)applyAim(target);}else if(!cfg.sticky)currentTarget=null;
  }
  function clickTeleport(){
    if(!activeCombat()||!cfg.playerClickTeleport)return false;const p=g.player,origin=P.eye,direction=P.forward;
    const result=g.physics.raycast?.(origin.x,origin.y,origin.z,direction.x,direction.y,direction.z,cfg.playerTeleportRange);if(!result||!Number.isFinite(result.t)||result.t<=0)return toast('No teleport surface in range.'),false;
    // Native ray hits reuse a scratch object; copy fields before clearance rays.
    const hit={t:result.t,nx:finite(result.nx),ny:finite(result.ny),nz:finite(result.nz)},point=origin.clone().add(direction.clone().multiplyScalar(hit.t));
    if(hit.ny<-.35)return toast('Aim at a floor or wall near a landing surface.'),false;
    const normal=vec(hit.nx,0,hit.nz);if(normal.length()<.01&&Math.abs(hit.ny)<.01)normal.copy(direction).multiplyScalar(-1);normal.y=0;if(normal.length()>.01)normal.normalize().multiplyScalar(finite(p.radius,.4064)+.12);
    const x=point.x+normal.x,z=point.z+normal.z,ground=g.physics.groundHeight?.(x,point.y+.15,z),y=finite(ground,NaN)+.06;
    if(!Number.isFinite(y)||y<finite(g.map?.voidY,-3)+.1||!clearPlayerPosition(p,x,y,z))return toast('Teleport destination is blocked or has no safe floor.'),false;
    Object.assign(p,{x,y,z,vx:0,vy:0,vz:0,onGround:false,onLadder:false,jumpBuffer:0,_safeX:x,_safeY:y,_safeZ:z,_stepLift:0,_stepHold:0});if(noclipState)noclipState.entry={x,y,z};stats.teleports=(stats.teleports||0)+1;return true;
  }
  listen(window,'mousedown',event=>{if(event.button!==0||!g.input.locked||!cfg.playerClickTeleport||!featureKeys.has(cfg.playerTeleportKey)||editing(event.target)||!activeCombat())return;consumeKey(event);g.input.mouse1=false;g.input.mouse1Pressed=false;clickTeleport();},{capture:true});

  function applyMenuLayout(force=false){
    const wanted=['compact','classic','fullscreen','dashboard'].includes(cfg.menuLayout)?cfg.menuLayout:'compact';cfg.menuLayout=wanted;
    const signature=wanted+'|'+innerWidth+'|'+innerHeight;if(!force&&signature===menuLayoutApplied)return;
    const searching=panel.querySelector('#dlGlobalSearch').value;if(searching){panel.querySelector('#dlGlobalSearch').value='';filterMenu();}
    const previous=panel.dataset.layout||'compact',wasTabbed=previous==='classic'||previous==='fullscreen';
    if(tabbedMenu()&&!wasTabbed)menuDetailState=new Map(menuSections.map(s=>[s,s.open]));
    if(!tabbedMenu()&&wasTabbed&&menuDetailState){for(const[s,open]of menuDetailState)s.open=open;menuDetailState=null;}
    panel.dataset.layout=wanted;menuLayoutApplied=signature;
    Object.assign(panel.style,{left:'',right:'',top:'',bottom:'',width:'',height:'',maxHeight:''});
    if(wanted==='compact'){Object.assign(panel.style,{right:'12px',top:'12px',width:Math.min(390,Math.max(260,innerWidth-24))+'px',maxHeight:'calc(100vh - 24px)'});}
    else{const width=wanted==='fullscreen'?Math.max(280,innerWidth-24):Math.min(wanted==='classic'?940:1120,Math.max(280,innerWidth-32));const height=wanted==='fullscreen'?Math.max(220,innerHeight-24):Math.min(760,Math.max(220,innerHeight-40));Object.assign(panel.style,{left:Math.max(0,(innerWidth-width)/2)+'px',top:Math.max(0,(innerHeight-height)/2)+'px',width:width+'px',height:height+'px',maxHeight:'calc(100vh - 24px)'});}

  }

  function syncMenuBackground(){

  async function decodeMenuBgFile(file){
    if(typeof window.createImageBitmap==='function')return window.createImageBitmap(file);
    return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const url=URL.createObjectURL(file),image=new window.Image();image.onload=()=>{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);resolve(image);};image.onerror=()=>{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);reject(Error('Could not decode this image.'));};image.src=url;});
  }
  async function uploadMenuBackground(file){
    const serial=++menuBgSerial;
    if(!file||!['image/png','image/jpeg','image/webp'].includes(file.type))throw Error('Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.');
    if(!Number.isFinite(file.size)||file.size<1||file.size>3*1024*1024)throw Error('Image must be smaller than 3 MB.');
    let image;
    try{

  let spoofHud=null,spoofSignature='',spoofRosterSignature='',spoofInSync=false,spoofWasActive=false,spoofUploadSerial={player:0,bots:0},spoofAssetRevision=0,spoofOrderKey='',spoofOrder=[];

  function spoofText(text,max=32){return Array.from(String(text??'').replace(/[<>\x26"'\x00-\x1f\x7f\u202a-\u202e\u2066-\u2069]/g,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()).slice(0,max).join('');}
  function spoofPool(text){return String(text||'').split(/[\n,;]+/).map(value=>spoofText(value)).filter(Boolean).slice(0,64);}
  function spoofHash(text){let hash=2166136261;for(const char of text)hash=Math.imul(hash^char.codePointAt(0),16777619);return hash>>>0;}
  function validSpoofImage(value){return typeof value==='string'&&value.length<180000&&/^data:image\/(?:png|jpeg|webp);base64,[a-z0-9+/=]+$/i.test(value);}
  function spoofOwnAlias(){const name=spoofText(cfg.spoofPlayerAlias)||'Player',tag=spoofText(cfg.spoofClanTag,12);return spoofText((tag?'['+tag+'] ':'')+name,48);}
  function spoofBotAlias(bot,index){
    const manual=spoofOverrides.get(bot);if(manual)return manual;
    const mode=cfg.spoofBotMode,prefix=spoofText(cfg.spoofBotPrefix,12),key=mode+'|'+cfg.spoofBotList+'|'+cfg.spoofShuffleSeed;if(key!==spoofOrderKey){spoofOrderKey=key;const pool=mode==='custom'?spoofPool(cfg.spoofBotList):spoofCalls;spoofOrder=pool.map((name,i)=>({name,sort:spoofHash(name+'|'+cfg.spoofShuffleSeed+'|'+i)})).sort((a,b)=>a.sort-b.sort);}const order=spoofOrder;
    let name;if(mode==='numbers')name=(prefix||'BOT')+' '+String(index+1).padStart(2,'0');else if(mode==='teams')name=(bot.team==='CT'?spoofText(cfg.spoofCTLabel,16)||'CT':spoofText(cfg.spoofTLabel,16)||'T')+' '+String(index+1).padStart(2,'0');else name=(prefix?prefix+' ':'')+(order[index%order.length]?.name||'BOT')+(index>=order.length?' '+(index+1):'');
    const tag=cfg.spoofTagBots?spoofText(cfg.spoofClanTag,12):'';return spoofText((tag?'['+tag+'] ':'')+name,48);
  }
  function writeSpoofName(entity,name){
    let record=spoofNameRecords.get(entity);if(!record){if(entity.name===name)return false;record={own:Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(entity,'name'),original:entity.name,last:entity.name};spoofNameRecords.set(entity,record);}else if(entity.name!==record.last){record.own=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(entity,'name');record.original=entity.name;}
    if(entity.name===name)return false;entity.name=name;record.last=name;return true;
  }
  function restoreSpoofName(entity){const record=spoofNameRecords.get(entity);if(!record)return false;let changed=false;if(entity.name===record.last){if(record.own)Object.defineProperty(entity,'name',record.own);else delete entity.name;changed=true;}spoofNameRecords.delete(entity);return changed;}
  function syncSpoofNames(){
    let changed=false;const active=!stopped&&isSolo(),bots=g.botMgr?.bots?.slice(0,128)||[],wanted=new Set();
    if(active&&cfg.spoofPlayerNameEnabled&&g.player){wanted.add(g.player);changed=writeSpoofName(g.player,spoofOwnAlias())||changed;}
    bots.forEach((bot,index)=>{if(!spoofEntityIds.has(bot))spoofEntityIds.set(bot,index+1);});if(active&&cfg.spoofBotNamesEnabled)bots.forEach((bot,index)=>{wanted.add(bot);changed=writeSpoofName(bot,spoofBotAlias(bot,index))||changed;});
    for(const entity of [...spoofNameRecords.keys()])if(!wanted.has(entity))changed=restoreSpoofName(entity)||changed;return changed;
  }
  function spoofAvatarFor(entity,index=0,preview=false){
    if(!entity)return'';const self=entity===g.player||entity.isPlayer,side=self?'player':'bots';if(!preview&&(stopped||!isSolo()||!cfg[self?'spoofPlayerAvatarEnabled':'spoofBotAvatarsEnabled']))return'';
    index=self?0:spoofEntityIds.get(entity)??index;let mode=cfg[self?'spoofPlayerAvatarMode':'spoofBotAvatarMode'];if(mode==='native')return'';if(mode==='custom'&&validSpoofImage(spoofAssets[side]))return spoofAssets[side];if(mode==='custom')mode='initials';
    const name=self?spoofOwnAlias():entity.name||'BOT',color=/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(cfg.spoofAvatarColor)?cfg.spoofAvatarColor:'#69b6ff',hash=spoofHash(name+'|'+index+'|'+cfg.spoofShuffleSeed);if(mode==='variety')mode=['initials','identicon','badge'][hash%3];
    const key=[mode,name,color,entity.team,index,cfg.spoofAvatarShape].join('|');if(spoofAvatarCache.has(key))return spoofAvatarCache.get(key);
    const radius=cfg.spoofAvatarShape==='circle'?64:cfg.spoofAvatarShape==='square'?0:20;let body='';
    if(mode==='identicon'){for(let y=0;y<5;y++)for(let x=0;x<3;x++)if((spoofHash(hash+'|'+x+'|'+y)&1)!==0){body+='<rect x="'+(14+x*20)+'" y="'+(14+y*20)+'" width="18" height="18" fill="'+color+'"/>';if(x<2)body+='<rect x="'+(14+(4-x)*20)+'" y="'+(14+y*20)+'" width="18" height="18" fill="'+color+'"/>';}}
    else if(mode==='badge'){const ct=entity.team==='CT';body='<path d="M64 16 L104 32 L97 83 L64 112 L31 83 L24 32 Z" fill="'+(ct?'#4777b8':'#ae6440')+'" stroke="'+color+'" stroke-width="4"/><text x="64" y="76" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff" font-size="34" font-family="sans-serif" font-weight="700">'+(ct?'CT':'T')+'</text>';}
    else{const initials=Array.from(spoofText(name).split(' ').map(word=>Array.from(word)[0]||'').join('').toUpperCase()).slice(0,2).join('')||'?';body='<circle cx="64" cy="64" r="49" fill="'+color+'" opacity=".18"/><text x="64" y="79" text-anchor="middle" fill="'+color+'" font-size="43" font-family="sans-serif" font-weight="700">'+initials+'</text>';}
    const svg='<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="128" height="128"><defs><clipPath id="clip"><rect width="128" height="128" rx="'+radius+'"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#clip)"><rect width="128" height="128" fill="#172333"/>'+body+'</g></svg>',url='data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,'+encodeURIComponent(svg).replace(/[!'()*]/g,c=>'%'+c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase());
    if(spoofAvatarCache.size>=96)spoofAvatarCache.clear();spoofAvatarCache.set(key,url);return url;
  }
  function spoofRadius(){return cfg.spoofAvatarShape==='circle'?'50%':cfg.spoofAvatarShape==='square'?'0':'20%';}
  function clearSpoofScoreStyles(){spoofScoreStyles.clear();if(spoofAvatarStyle)spoofAvatarStyle.textContent='';}
  function spoofScoreClass(entity,index,src){
    const self=entity===g.player||entity.isPlayer,custom=src===spoofAssets[self?'player':'bots'],id=custom?(self?'self-image':'bots-image'):(self?'self':String(spoofEntityIds.get(entity)??index+1)),name='dl-spoof-avatar-'+id,rule='#scoreboard .CSGOAvatarImage.'+name+'{background-image:url("'+src+'")!important;background-size:cover!important;background-position:center!important;border-radius:'+spoofRadius()+'!important}';
    if(spoofScoreStyles.get(name)!==rule){if(!spoofAvatarStyle){spoofAvatarStyle=document.createElement('style');document.head.appendChild(spoofAvatarStyle);}if(spoofScoreStyles.size>=132)spoofScoreStyles.clear();spoofScoreStyles.set(name,rule);spoofAvatarStyle.textContent=[...spoofScoreStyles.values()].join('\n');}return name;

  function spoofDomValue(node,key){if(key==='src')return node.getAttribute?.('src')??node.attributes?.src??node.src??null;return node.style.getPropertyValue?.(key)||node.style[key]||'';}
  function spoofDomWrite(node,key,value,priority=''){if(key==='src'){if(value===null){node.removeAttribute?.('src');if(!node.removeAttribute)node.src='';}else if(node.setAttribute)node.setAttribute('src',value);else node.src=value;}else node.style.setProperty(key,value,priority);}
  function patchSpoofDom(node,key,value){let records=spoofDomRecords.get(node);if(!records){records=new Map();spoofDomRecords.set(node,records);}let record=records.get(key);if(!record){record={original:spoofDomValue(node,key),priority:node.style.getPropertyPriority?.(key)||'',last:value};records.set(key,record);}const current=spoofDomValue(node,key);if(current!==record.last&&current!==value){record.original=current;record.priority=node.style.getPropertyPriority?.(key)||'';}if(current!==value)spoofDomWrite(node,key,value);record.last=value;}
  function restoreSpoofDom(node){const records=spoofDomRecords.get(node);if(!records)return;for(const[key,record]of records)if(spoofDomValue(node,key)===record.last)spoofDomWrite(node,key,record.original,record.priority);spoofDomRecords.delete(node);}

  async function uploadSpoofAvatar(side,file){
    if(!['player','bots'].includes(side))throw Error('Choose player or bots.');if(!file)return;if(!['image/png','image/jpeg','image/webp'].includes(file.type)||file.size>2*1024*1024)throw Error('Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 2 MB.');const token=++spoofUploadSerial[side];
    let image,url;try{const decode=window.createImageBitmap||globalThis.createImageBitmap;if(decode)image=await decode(file);else{const ImageType=window.Image||globalThis.Image;if(!ImageType)throw Error('Image decoding is unavailable.');url=URL.createObjectURL(file);image=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const img=new ImageType();img.onload=()=>resolve(img);img.onerror=()=>reject(Error('Image could not be decoded.'));img.src=url;});}
      const width=image.width||image.naturalWidth,height=image.height||image.naturalHeight;if(!width||!height||width>4096||height>4096||width*height>16777216)throw Error('Use an image at most 4096 x 4096 pixels.');if(stopped||token!==spoofUploadSerial[side])return;
      const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=canvas.height=256;const context=canvas.getContext('2d');context.fillStyle='#172333';context.fillRect(0,0,256,256);const size=Math.min(width,height);context.drawImage(image,(width-size)/2,(height-size)/2,size,size,0,0,256,256);const data=canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.88);if(!validSpoofImage(data))throw Error('Avatar could not be resized.');const next={...spoofAssets,[side]:data};localStorage.setItem(SPOOF_ASSETS,JSON.stringify(next));spoofAssets=next;spoofAssetRevision++;cfg[side==='player'?'spoofPlayerAvatarMode':'spoofBotAvatarMode']='custom';panel.querySelectorAll('[data-k]').forEach(syncControl);save();syncSpoofer();toast('Avatar saved locally. Enable its avatar switch to display it.');
    }finally{image?.close?.();if(url)URL.revokeObjectURL(url);}
  }

  }

disappear.\n      // Retain them in files with eval or nontrivial Function constructors.\n      let dynamicReferences = false;\n      walk(ast, node => {\n        if (node.type === \"Identifier\" &&   function showHello(){if(stopped)return;for(const[k,v]of Object.entries({'--dl-bg':cfg.themeBg,'--dl-head':cfg.themeHeader,'--dl-surface':cfg.themeSurface,'--dl-text':cfg.themeText,'--dl-accent':cfg.themeAccent,'--dl-border':cfg.themeBorder}))helloRoot.style.setProperty(k,v);helloRoot.hidden=false;helloSplashVisible=true;document.body.appendChild(helloRoot);showPanel(true);input.exitLock();refreshHello(true);}
  function dismissHello(){if(!helloSplashVisible)return false;helloSplashVisible=false;helloRoot.hidden=true;helloRoot.remove();clearFeatureKeys();showPanel(true);return true;}
  function dismissHelloFromInput(event){if(!helloSplashVisible)return false;event.preventDefault?.();event.stopPropagation?.();event.stopImmediatePropagation?.();dismissHello();return true;}
  listen(window,'pointerdown',event=>{if(helloSplashVisible)dismissHelloFromInput(event);},{capture:true});
  helloEl('Continue').onclick=dismissHello;
  helloBaselineFingerprint=helloFingerprint();helloReady=true;refreshHello(true);showHello();
  cleanups.push(()=>{helloReady=false;helloSplashVisible=false;helloRoot.remove();helloMeta=Object.create(null);});

  // A small Canvas 2D sample scene; no extra WebGL context, map clone or game hook.
  const worldPreviewCanvas=panel.querySelector('#dlWorldPreviewCanvas'),worldPreviewCtx=worldPreviewCanvas.getContext('2d');
  let worldPreviewYaw=0,worldPreviewPitch=0,worldPreviewDrag=null,worldPreviewStamp='',worldPreviewLast=-Infinity,worldPreviewFrames=0;
  const wpColor=hex=>{const n=parseInt(String(hex).replace('#',''),16)||0;return[(n>>16&255)/255,(n>>8&255)/255,(n&255)/255];};
  const wpMix=(a,b,t)=>a.map((v,i)=>v*(1-t)+b[i]*t),wpScale=(a,n)=>a.map(v=>v*n),wpCss=a=>'rgb('+a.map(v=>Math.round(clamp(v,0,1)*255)).join(',')+')';
  function wpSurface(hex,kind,light,depth,c){
    let albedo=wpColor(hex),color=wpScale(albedo,light),flat=c.worldMaxFps;
    if(flat){if(c.worldFpsPalette)albedo=wpColor({wall:c.worldFpsWall,floor:c.worldFpsFloor,prop:c.worldFpsProps,ct:c.worldFpsCT,t:c.worldFpsT}[kind]||hex);color=wpScale(albedo,1-(1-light)*clamp(c.worldFpsShade,0,1));}
    else if(c.worldShaderEnabled&&c.worldShaderStyle!=='natural'){
      const luma=color[0]*.2126+color[1]*.7152+color[2]*.0722,tone=1-Math.exp(-luma*1.15),black=wpColor(c.worldBlack);
      let ink=black;if(albedo[2]>albedo[0]*1.12&&albedo[2]>albedo[1]*1.06)ink=wpColor(c.worldBlue);else if(albedo[1]>albedo[0]*1.12&&albedo[1]>albedo[2]*1.06)ink=wpColor(c.worldGreen);else if(albedo[0]>albedo[2]*1.35&&albedo[1]>albedo[2]*1.15)ink=wpColor(c.worldOrange);else if(albedo[0]>albedo[1]*1.15&&albedo[2]>albedo[1]*1.1)ink=wpColor(c.worldPurple);else if(albedo[0]>albedo[1]*1.12&&albedo[0]>albedo[2]*1.06)ink=wpColor(c.worldRed);
      const style=c.worldShaderStyle,paper=wpColor(style==='midnight'||style==='neon'?'#d6d6f0':style==='sketch'?'#f5dbb3':style==='mono'?'#dedede':'#fffdf5');let styled=color;
      if(style==='paper'){const bands=Math.floor(tone*5+.5)/5,t=clamp((bands-.02)/.88,0,1);styled=wpMix(ink,paper,t*t*(3-2*t)).map((v,i)=>v*(.84+.16*clamp(albedo[i]*1.5,0,1)));}
      else if(style==='midnight')styled=wpMix(black,ink,.48).map((v,i)=>v*(.25+tone*.9)+color[i]*.35);
      else if(style==='sketch')styled=wpMix(ink,paper,tone).map((v,i)=>v*[1.02,.95,.84][i]);
      else if(style==='neon')styled=wpMix(black,ink,.58).map((v,i)=>v*(.25+tone*1.65)+color[i]*.35+ink[i]*Math.pow(tone,3)*.3);
      else if(style==='mono')styled=wpMix(black,paper,tone);
      color=wpMix(color,styled,clamp(c.worldShaderStrength,0,1));
    }
    if(!flat&&c.fogEnabled){let fade=c.fogMode==='exp'?1-Math.exp(-Math.pow(c.fogDensity*depth,2)):clamp((depth-c.fogNear)/(Math.max(c.fogNear+1,c.fogFar)-c.fogNear),0,1);if(c.fogMode==='linear')fade=fade*fade*(3-2*fade);color=wpMix(color,wpColor(c.fogColor),fade);}
    return wpCss(color);
  }
  function wpSky(ctx,w,h,c,time){
    const native=originalBackground?.getHexString?.();const top=c.worldSkyEnabled?c.worldPaper:c.worldMaxFps?c.worldFpsSky:native?'#'+native:'#91afc2',horizon=c.worldSkyEnabled?c.worldSkyHorizon:c.worldMaxFps?c.worldFpsSky:'#e6ddd0';
    const gradient=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,h*.8);gradient.addColorStop(0,top);gradient.addColorStop(1,horizon);ctx.fillStyle=gradient;ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
    const style=c.worldSkyEnabled?c.worldSkyPreset:'custom',phase=c.worldSkyAnimate?time*.035:0;
    if(style==='day'||style==='sunset'||c.worldSkyClouds&&c.worldSkyEnabled){const x=w*.72,y=h*(style==='sunset'?.36:.13),sun=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,2,x,y,w*.13);sun.addColorStop(0,'#ffe9bba0');sun.addColorStop(1,'#ffddaa00');ctx.fillStyle=sun;ctx.fillRect(x-w*.13,y-w*.13,w*.26,w*.26);}
    if(style==='night'||style==='aurora')for(let i=0;i<58;i++){const x=((Math.sin(i*17.41)*433.73)%1+1)%1*w,y=((Math.sin(i*8.31)*211.32)%1+1)%1*h*.44;ctx.fillStyle=i%5?'#ccd9eb90':'#e9f6ff';ctx.fillRect(x,y,i%5?1:2,i%5?1:2);}
    if(style==='aurora'){ctx.save();for(let j=0;j<3;j++){ctx.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<=30;i++){const x=i*w/30,y=h*(.1+j*.07)+Math.sin(i*.23+phase+j)*h*.06;i?ctx.lineTo(x,y):ctx.moveTo(x,y);}ctx.strokeStyle=['#48dba438','#70cfd52c','#c698ed25'][j];ctx.lineWidth=h*.09;ctx.stroke();}ctx.restore();}
    if(style==='storm'||c.worldSkyClouds&&c.worldSkyEnabled){ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle=style==='storm'?'#15243155':'#ffffff30';for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const x=((i*.23+phase*.07)%1)*w,y=h*(.11+(i%3)*.05);ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,w*.16,h*.035,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}ctx.restore();}
  }
  function wpScene(ctx,w,h,c,time){
    ctx.save();if(c.worldEnabled&&!c.worldMaxFps)ctx.filter='brightness('+c.worldBrightness+') contrast('+c.worldContrast+') saturate('+c.worldSaturation+') hue-rotate('+c.worldHue+'deg)';wpSky(ctx,w,h,c,time);ctx.fillStyle=wpSurface('#98938a','floor',.93,5,c);ctx.fillRect(0,h*.48,w,h*.52);
    const range=helloPrefs.previewScene==='range',alley=helloPrefs.previewScene==='alley',center=[0,1.3,range?-20:-7],radius=alley?14:range?31:17,yaw=worldPreviewYaw;
    const camera=[Math.sin(yaw)*radius,4.5+worldPreviewPitch*4,center[2]+Math.cos(yaw)*radius],f=center.map((v,i)=>v-camera[i]),length=Math.hypot(...f);for(let i=0;i<3;i++)f[i]/=length;
    const right=[-f[2],0,f[0]],rlen=Math.hypot(...right);for(let i=0;i<3;i++)right[i]/=rlen;const up=[right[1]*f[2]-right[2]*f[1],right[2]*f[0]-right[0]*f[2],right[0]*f[1]-right[1]*f[0]],scale=Math.min(w*.65,h*1.18);
    const project=p=>{const a=p.map((v,i)=>v-camera[i]),z=a.reduce((n,v,i)=>n+v*f[i],0);if(z<.5)return null;return{x:w/2+a.reduce((n,v,i)=>n+v*right[i],0)*scale/z,y:h*.48-a.reduce((n,v,i)=>n+v*up[i],0)*scale/z,depth:z};};
    const faces=[];
    function face(points,color,kind,light=.9){const p=points.map(project);if(p.some(q=>!q))return;const depth=p.reduce((n,q)=>n+q.depth,0)/p.length;faces.push({p,depth,color:wpSurface(color,kind,light,depth,c),lines:!c.worldMaxFps&&c.worldShaderEnabled&&Number(c.worldLines)>0,kind});}
    function box(x,y,z,ww,hh,dd,color,kind='prop'){
      const a=x-ww/2,b=x+ww/2,l=z-dd/2,r=z+dd/2,top=y+hh;
      face([[a,y,l],[b,y,l],[b,top,l],[a,top,l]],color,kind,.71);face([[b,y,r],[a,y,r],[a,top,r],[b,top,r]],color,kind,.91);
      face([[a,y,r],[a,y,l],[a,top,l],[a,top,r]],color,kind,.8);face([[b,y,l],[b,y,r],[b,top,r],[b,top,l]],color,kind,.65);face([[a,top,l],[b,top,l],[b,top,r],[a,top,r]],color,kind,1);
    }
    const lengthZ=range?160:28,widthX=alley?4.6:10;
    for(let z=-lengthZ;z<8;z+=8)face([[-widthX,0,z],[widthX,0,z],[widthX,0,z+8],[-widthX,0,z+8]],'#98938a','floor',.93);
    for(let z=-lengthZ;z<4;z+=8){box(-widthX-.3,0,z,.6,4.8,8,'#b8a994','wall');box(widthX+.3,0,z,.6,4.8,8,'#b8a994','wall');if(!c.worldMaxFps){box(-widthX-.05,3.4,z,.06,.1,8,'#704b38','wall');box(widthX+.05,3.4,z,.06,.1,8,'#704b38','wall');}}
    box(0,0,-lengthZ-2,widthX*2+1,5,.5,'#a89987','wall');box(-widthX+.04,.2,-10,.08,3,4,'#405f93','wall');box(widthX-.04,.2,-17,.08,3,4,'#934747','wall');
    for(const[x,z,color]of[[-2,-8,'#95754a'],[2,-13,'#4d7357'],[-2.8,-20,'#78608b']])box(x,0,z,alley?1.2:2.1,alley?1.4:2.3,1.7,color);
    if(range)for(const z of[-40,-70,-110,-145])box((z%3-1)*2,0,z,2,2.5,2,'#527552');
    for(const[x,z,team]of[[1,-6,'ct'],[-1.5,-15,'t']]){const color=team==='ct'?'#537ea1':'#ad7950';box(x,.75,z,.46,.72,.3,color,team);box(x,1.48,z,.27,.28,.26,'#d5ad87',team);for(const side of[-1,1]){box(x+side*.13,0,z,.15,.75,.19,color,team);box(x+side*.31,.82,z,.14,.62,.15,color,team);}}
    faces.sort((a,b)=>b.depth-a.depth);for(const item of faces){const p=item.p;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p[0].x,p[0].y);for(const q of p.slice(1))ctx.lineTo(q.x,q.y);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=item.color;ctx.fill();if(item.lines){ctx.strokeStyle=rgba(c.worldBlack,.24);ctx.lineWidth=.6;ctx.stroke();}}
    // Foreground range marks make fog depth and ground shading easier to compare.
    for(const distance of range?[20,50,100]:[5,15,25]){const p=project([0,.03,-distance]);if(p&&p.x>0&&p.x<w&&p.y>0&&p.y<h){ctx.fillStyle=wpSurface('#fff4cd','floor',1,p.depth,c);ctx.font='10px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(Math.round(p.depth)+'m',p.x,p.y);}}
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function refreshWorldPreview(force=false){
    if(stopped||!worldPreviewCtx||!force&&!helloSectionVisible('WORLD'))return false;
    if(!force){const r=worldPreviewCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.bottom<=0||r.top>=innerHeight||r.right<=0||r.left>=innerWidth)return false;}
    const now=performance.now(),animated=cfg.worldSkyEnabled&&cfg.worldSkyAnimate,values=Object.keys(defaults).filter(k=>k.startsWith('world')||k.startsWith('fog')).map(k=>[k,cfg[k]]),stamp=JSON.stringify([values,helloPrefs.previewScene,helloPrefs.previewCompare,worldPreviewYaw,worldPreviewPitch]);
    if(!force&&now-worldPreviewLast<1000/20)return false;
    if(!force&&stamp===worldPreviewStamp&&(!animated||now-worldPreviewLast<1000/15))return false;
    worldPreviewStamp=stamp;worldPreviewLast=now;worldPreviewFrames++;
    const ctx=worldPreviewCtx,w=worldPreviewCanvas.width,h=worldPreviewCanvas.height;ctx.save();ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);

    else wpScene(ctx,w,h,cfg,now/1000);
    ctx.restore();panel.querySelector('#dlWorldPreviewMode').textContent=cfg.worldMaxFps?'Max FPS · '+cfg.worldFpsResolution+'% game scale':cfg.worldShaderEnabled?cfg.worldShaderStyle+' · '+Math.round(cfg.worldShaderStrength*100)+'%':'Original'+(cfg.worldEnabled?' + color filter':'');return true;
  }

  // Multiplayer is embedded and starts only after the user's Connect action.
  const MP_STORE='clutcher_doodle_multiplayer_v1',MP_DEFAULT='wss://v2-clutcher-multiplayer.onrender.com';
  let mpOwned=false,mpPage='rooms',mpLastRefresh=-Infinity,mpRenderStamp='',mpPendingUntil=0,mpLastRoom=null,mpMessage='';
  const mpEl=id=>panel.querySelector('#dlMP'+id),mpPanel=panel.querySelector('#dlMultiplayer');
  function mpNotice(value){mpMessage=String(value||'').slice(0,250);const el=mpEl('Message');if(el)el.textContent=mpMessage;mpRenderStamp='';}
  let mpSaved={};try{mpSaved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(MP_STORE)||'{}')||{};}catch{}
  function mpValidServer(value){try{const u=new URL(String(value).trim());if(u.protocol==='https:')u.protocol='wss:';if(u.protocol!=='wss:'&&!(u.protocol==='ws:'&&['localhost','127.0.0.1','[::1]'].includes(u.hostname)))return '';if(u.username||u.password||u.hash||!u.hostname)return '';return u.href;}catch{return '';}}
  mpEl('Server').value=mpValidServer(mpSaved.server)||MP_DEFAULT;

  function mpPersist(){try{localStorage.setItem(MP_STORE,JSON.stringify({server:mpEl('Server').value}));localStorage.setItem('connections_player_name',mpEl('Name').value.trim().slice(0,24)||'Player');}catch{}}
  function mpChoose(page){mpPage=['rooms','lobby','chat','profile'].includes(page)?page:'rooms';for(const el of mpPanel.querySelectorAll('[data-mp-view]'))el.hidden=el.dataset.mpView!==mpPage;for(const el of mpPanel.querySelectorAll('[data-mp-page]'))el.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(el.dataset.mpPage===mpPage));mpRenderStamp='';}
    // Regional tests use temporary, unidentified sockets; they never join rooms.
  const MP_SERVERS=Object.freeze([
    Object.freeze({id:'na',name:'NA',region:'North America',url:'wss://v2-clutcher-multiplayer.onrender.com/'}),
    Object.freeze({id:'eu',name:'EU',region:'Europe',url:'wss://v2-clutcher-multiplayer-eu.onrender.com/'}),
    Object.freeze({id:'apac',name:'APAC',region:'Asia Pacific',url:'wss://v2-clutcher-multiplayer-ali0.onrender.com/'})
  ]);
  let mpPingJob=null;
  const mpPingResults=new Map();
  function mpCurrentRegion(){const url=mpValidServer(mpEl('Server').value);return MP_SERVERS.find(s=>s.url===url);}
  function mpServerBusy(){const S=mpOwned?window.__connections_multiplayer?.state:null;return !!(S?.connected||S?.connecting||S?.room||mpPendingUntil>performance.now());}
  function mpBestServer(){return MP_SERVERS.filter(s=>mpPingResults.get(s.id)?.status==='ok').sort((a,b)=>mpPingResults.get(a.id).ms-mpPingResults.get(b.id).ms)[0]||null;}
  function mpSyncRegion(){mpEl('Region').value=mpCurrentRegion()?.id||'custom';}
  function mpSetServer(value){
    if(stopped)return false;
    if(mpServerBusy()){mpEl('Server').value=mpValidServer(window.__connections_multiplayer?.state.ws?.url||mpSaved.server)||MP_DEFAULT;mpSyncRegion();mpNotice('Leave your room and disconnect before changing servers.');return false;}
    const url=mpValidServer(value);
    if(!url){mpEl('Server').value=mpValidServer(mpSaved.server)||MP_DEFAULT;mpSyncRegion();mpNotice('Use a valid wss:// WebSocket address.');return false;}
    mpEl('Server').value=url;mpSaved.server=url;mpPersist();mpSyncRegion();mpRenderStamp='';
    mpNotice((mpCurrentRegion()?.name||'Custom')+' selected. Connect to browse this server’s rooms.');
    refreshDoodleMultiplayer(true);return true;
  }
  function selectDoodleServer(id){const entry=MP_SERVERS.find(s=>s.id===String(id).toLowerCase());return entry?mpSetServer(entry.url):false;}
  function mpServerReport(){return MP_SERVERS.map(s=>({...s,selected:mpCurrentRegion()?.id===s.id,...(mpPingResults.get(s.id)||{status:'unchecked'})}));}
  function mpRefreshServerControls(){
    const busy=mpServerBusy(),best=mpBestServer(),selected=mpCurrentRegion();
    mpEl('Region').disabled=busy;mpEl('UseBest').disabled=busy||!!mpPingJob||!best;
    mpEl('CheckPing').textContent=mpPingJob?'CANCEL CHECK':'CHECK PING';
    const rows=mpEl('PingResults');rows.replaceChildren();
    for(const entry of MP_SERVERS){
      const result=mpPingResults.get(entry.id),row=document.createElement('div');row.className='dl-mp-ping-row';
      row.dataset.selected=String(selected?.id===entry.id);row.dataset.status=result?.status||'unchecked';
      const label=mpText('span',entry.name),value=mpText('b',result?.status==='ok'?result.ms+' ms':({queued:'Waiting…',connecting:'Connecting / waking…',measuring:'Measuring…',error:'Unavailable',cancelled:'Cancelled'}[result?.status]||'Not checked'));
      row.title=entry.region+(result?.status==='ok'?' · median of '+result.samples+' samples · connection '+(result.connectMs/1000).toFixed(1)+'s measured separately':result?.message?' · '+result.message:'');row.append(label,value);rows.append(row);
    }
    mpEl('BestPing').textContent=mpPingJob?'Checking regions…':best?'Best measured: '+best.name+' · '+mpPingResults.get(best.id).ms+' ms':'Check ping to compare regions. A sleeping server may take time to connect.';
    const health=mpEl('Health'),url=mpValidServer(mpEl('Server').value);
    if(url){health.href=url.replace(/^wss:/,'https:').replace(/^ws:/,'http:');health.textContent=(selected?.name||'Selected')+' server / health';}
  }
  function cancelDoodleServerPings(silent=false){
    const job=mpPingJob;if(!job)return false;mpPingJob=null;job.cancelled=true;
    for(const cancel of [...job.tasks])cancel();
    for(const entry of MP_SERVERS){const result=mpPingResults.get(entry.id);if(result&&['queued','connecting','measuring'].includes(result.status))mpPingResults.set(entry.id,{status:'cancelled',message:'Check cancelled.'});}
    if(!stopped){mpRefreshServerControls();if(!silent)mpNotice('Ping check cancelled. Your multiplayer connection is unchanged.');}return true;
  }
  function mpProbeServer(entry,job){
    return new Promise(resolve=>{
      let socket,done=false,openedAt=0,pendingAt=null,warm=false;
      const samples=[],timers=new Set(),started=performance.now();
      function later(fn,ms){const id=setTimeout(()=>{timers.delete(id);if(!done)fn();},ms);timers.add(id);return id;}
      function clear(id){clearTimeout(id);timers.delete(id);}
      function finish(result){
        if(done)return;done=true;for(const id of timers)clearTimeout(id);timers.clear();job.tasks.delete(cancel);
        if(socket){socket.onopen=null;socket.onmessage=null;socket.onerror=null;socket.onclose=null;try{socket.close();}catch{}}
        resolve(result);
      }
      const cancel=()=>finish({status:'cancelled',message:'Check cancelled.'});job.tasks.add(cancel);
      if(job.cancelled||stopped){cancel();return;}
      let responseTimer,connectTimer;
      function sendPing(){
        if(job.cancelled||stopped)return cancel();
        pendingAt=performance.now();responseTimer=later(()=>finish({status:'error',message:'No application ping reply. Check that this is a compatible v2 WebSocket server.'}),3500);
        try{socket.send(JSON.stringify({type:'ping',t:Date.now()}));}catch{finish({status:'error',message:'Could not send a ping.'});}
      }
      try{socket=new WebSocket(entry.url);}catch{finish({status:'error',message:'The browser could not open this WebSocket address.'});return;}
      connectTimer=later(()=>finish({status:'error',message:'Connection timed out. The service may still be starting; try again.'}),75000);
      socket.onopen=()=>{clear(connectTimer);openedAt=performance.now();mpPingResults.set(entry.id,{status:'measuring'});if(mpPingJob===job&&!stopped)mpRefreshServerControls();sendPing();};
      socket.onmessage=event=>{
        if(done)return;let data;try{data=JSON.parse(event.data);}catch{return;}
        if(data?.type==='connected'&&data.version&&!/^2\.0\.\d+$/.test(String(data.version)))return finish({status:'error',message:'Server version '+String(data.version).slice(0,30)+' is incompatible with this client.'});
        if(data?.type!=='pong'||pendingAt===null)return;
        const elapsed=Math.max(0,performance.now()-pendingAt);pendingAt=null;clear(responseTimer);
        if(warm)samples.push(elapsed);else warm=true;
        if(samples.length===5){const sorted=[...samples].sort((a,b)=>a-b);return finish({status:'ok',ms:Math.round(sorted[2]),minMs:Math.round(sorted[0]),maxMs:Math.round(sorted[4]),samples:5,connectMs:Math.round(openedAt-started),checkedAt:Date.now()});}
        later(sendPing,120);
      };
      socket.onerror=()=>finish({status:'error',message:'Connection failed or was blocked. Retry after the deployment is ready.'});
      socket.onclose=event=>finish({status:'error',message:event.code===1013?'Server is full; try again later.':'The server closed the test connection before it completed.'});
    });
  }
  async function checkDoodleServerPings(){
    if(stopped)return false;if(mpPingJob){cancelDoodleServerPings();return false;}
    const job={cancelled:false,tasks:new Set()};mpPingJob=job;let next=0;
    for(const entry of MP_SERVERS)mpPingResults.set(entry.id,{status:'queued'});
    mpRefreshServerControls();mpNotice('Checking server ping. Your selected server and any current match stay unchanged.');
    async function worker(){
      while(!job.cancelled&&!stopped&&next<MP_SERVERS.length){const entry=MP_SERVERS[next++];mpPingResults.set(entry.id,{status:'connecting'});mpRefreshServerControls();const result=await mpProbeServer(entry,job);if(mpPingJob!==job||stopped)return;mpPingResults.set(entry.id,result);mpRefreshServerControls();}
    }
    await Promise.all([worker(),worker()]);
    if(mpPingJob!==job||stopped)return false;mpPingJob=null;mpRefreshServerControls();
    const best=mpBestServer();mpNotice(best?'Ping check complete. Use '+best.name+' for the lowest measured server ping; everyone in a match must use the same server.':'No region replied. Check the deployments and retry; ping failure alone does not identify the cause.');
    return mpServerReport();
  }
  listen(mpEl('Region'),'change',()=>{const id=mpEl('Region').value;if(id==='custom'){if(mpServerBusy()){mpSyncRegion();return mpNotice('Disconnect before changing servers.');}mpChoose('profile');mpEl('Server').focus();mpNotice('Enter a custom WebSocket address in Profile.');return;}selectDoodleServer(id);});
  listen(mpEl('Server'),'change',()=>mpSetServer(mpEl('Server').value));
  mpEl('CheckPing').onclick=()=>{void checkDoodleServerPings();};
  mpEl('UseBest').onclick=()=>{const best=mpBestServer();if(best&&!mpPingJob)selectDoodleServer(best.id);};
  mpSyncRegion();mpRefreshServerControls();

    function installDoodleTeamPlay(){

  const clearInterval=id=>{ownedTimers.delete(id);PAGE.clearInterval(id);};
  const setTimeout=(fn,ms)=>{const id=PAGE.setTimeout(()=>{ownedTimeouts.delete(id);if(!disposed)fn();},ms);ownedTimeouts.add(id);return id;};
  function ownListen(obj,type,fn){obj.addEventListener(type,fn);ownedListeners.push(()=>obj.removeEventListener(type,fn));}
  const CONFIG = {
