    const old = participants.get(id);
    if (old?.nonce === packet[1] && packet[2] <= old.seq) return;
    const validRound = packet[3] === match.id && packet[4] === match.round;
    const rec = { id, nonce: packet[1], seq: packet[2], at: now(),
      use: validRound && !!packet[5], kit: !!packet[6], money: Math.max(0, Math.min(16000, num(packet[7]))),
      armor: Math.max(0, Math.min(100, num(packet[8]))), helmet: !!packet[9], weapon: String(packet[10]).slice(0, 24),
      kills: Math.max(0, Math.min(9999, packet[11] | 0)), deaths: Math.max(0, Math.min(9999, packet[12] | 0)),
      team: packet[13], mode: packet[14], map: packet[15], ready: !!packet[16], grenades: packet[17] };
    participants.set(id, rec);
    if (id !== String(S.id)) {
      const bot = entityFor(id);
      if (bot) { bot.hasKit = rec.kit; bot.money = rec.money; bot.kills = rec.kills; bot.deaths = rec.deaths; }
    }
  }
  function userTick() {
    const packet = collectUser(), signature = JSON.stringify(packet.slice(3));
    if (signature !== userSig || now() - lastUser >= (packet[5] ? 100 : 500)) {
      receiveUser(String(S.id), packet);
      if (send(packet)) { lastUser = now(); userSig = signature; }
    }
  }
  function setOwnTeam(value) {
    const p = g.player;
    if (p.team === value) return;
    p.team = value; g.viewmodel?.setTeam?.(value);
    g.hud.root?.classList?.toggle('team-ct', value === 'CT');
    g.hud.root?.classList?.toggle('team-t', value === 'T');
    g.hud.buildBuyMenu?.(value); g.hud.buildAvatars?.();
  }
  function correctModel(remote) {
    const bot = remote.bot, wanted = rosterFor(remote.id)?.[1] || participants.get(remote.id)?.team || team(remote.team);
    remote.team = wanted;
    if (!bot) return;
    bot.team = wanted; bot.isPlayer = false;
    const agent = bot.cs2Agent;
    if (!agent || !agent.team || agent.team === wanted || bot.__teamModelLoading === wanted || now() < (bot.__teamModelRetry || 0)) return;
    const generation = (bot.__teamModelGeneration || 0) + 1;
    bot.__teamModelGeneration = generation; bot.__teamModelLoading = wanted;
    agent.root.visible = false;
    try {
      const replacement = new agent.constructor(g.renderer);
      Promise.resolve(replacement.load(wanted)).then(result => {
        if (stopped || S.remotes.get(remote.id) !== remote || bot.__connectionsRemoved || remote.bot !== bot || bot.__teamModelGeneration !== generation || bot.team !== wanted) {
          result?.dispose?.(); return;
        }
        g.scene?.remove?.(agent.root); agent.dispose?.();
        bot.cs2Agent = result; g.scene?.add?.(result.root);
        bot._cs2Pending = false; bot._locoN = -1; bot._cs2WasAlive = false;
        bot.__teamModelLoading = ''; bot.__teamModelRetry = 0; metrics.modelsRebuilt++;
      }).catch(error => {
        try { replacement.dispose?.(); } catch {}
        bot.__teamModelLoading = ''; bot.__teamModelRetry = now() + 5000; metrics.errors++;
        if (metrics.errors < 5) PAGE.console.warn('[Team Play] Model reload:', error);
      });
    } catch (error) { bot.__teamModelLoading = ''; bot.__teamModelRetry = now() + 5000; metrics.errors++; }
  }
  function removeAI() {
    if (!S.room || !S.confirmedMatch || g.state !== 'playing' || !Array.isArray(g.botMgr?.bots)) return;
    for (const bot of [...g.botMgr.bots]) {
      if (bot.__connectionsRemote) continue;
      S.originalBots ||= []; if (!S.originalBots.includes(bot)) S.originalBots.push(bot);
      if (!S.botCtor) S.botCtor = bot.constructor;
      B.disableBot?.(bot); g.botMgr.bots.splice(g.botMgr.bots.indexOf(bot), 1); metrics.aiRemoved++;
    }
  }
  hook(B, 'preparePool', old => function(...args) { const result = old.apply(this, args); removeAI(); return result; });
  hook(B, 'receive', old => function(data) {
    const id = String(data?.id || ''), assigned = rosterFor(id)?.[1] || participants.get(id)?.team;
    if (assigned) data = data.state ? { ...data, state: { ...data.state, team: assigned } } : { ...data, team: assigned };
    const result = old.call(this, data); const remote = S.remotes.get(id);
    if (remote) { correctModel(remote); const r = rosterFor(id); if (remote.bot && match.started && (!r || r[2] > match.round)) remote.bot.alive = false; }
    return result;
  });
  function bindController() {
    if (ctl === g.modeCtl) return;
    ctl = g.modeCtl; if (!ctl) return;
    const required = ['nextRound', 'roundEnd', 'plant', 'explode', '_tossBomb', 'cleanupBomb', 'inSite', 'bombUseReach'];
    for (const name of required) if (typeof ctl[name] !== 'function') throw new Error('Unsupported Bomb Defuse method: ' + name);
    ctlNative = Object.fromEntries(required.map(name => [name, ctl[name]]));
    hook(ctl, 'update', old => function(dt) {
      if (!controlled()) return old.call(this, dt);
      g.frozen = !S.connected || !match.started || match.phase === 'freeze' || now() - lastReceived > 3500 && !isHost();
      g.respawnAllowed = false;
      if (this._shock) this._updateShock?.(Math.min(.05, Math.max(0, dt)));
      if (this.state === 'planted' && this.planted) {
        this.beepT = (this.beepT || 0) - dt;
        if (this.beepT <= 0) { this.beepT = .12 + Math.max(.06, this.bombT / 40) * .95;
          g.audio?.play?.(this.bombT < 10 ? 'beep_fast' : 'beep', { pos: this.planted }); }
      }
      g.viewmodel.action = this.carrier === g.player && this.plantProgress > 0 ? 'plant' :
        this.defuser === g.player && this.defuseProgress > 0 ? 'defuse' : null;
      if (g.viewmodel.action === 'plant') {
        if (g.weapons.slots[5] === 'c4' && g.weapons.current !== 'c4') g.weapons.equip('c4');
        if (g.cs2?.playTimed && g.cs2.has?.('plant') && g.cs2.rig?.current?.getClip?.().name !== 'plant') {
          g.cs2.playTimed('plant', Math.max(.25, 3.2 * (1 - this.plantProgress)), { fade: .05, idleAfter: 'idle' });
        }
      }
      g.player.forceCrouch = g.viewmodel.action !== null;
      this.plantHeld = false;
    });
    for (const name of ['roundEnd', 'nextRound', 'onKill', 'halftime', 'matchEnd', 'plant', 'explode']) {
      hook(ctl, name, old => function(...args) { if (controlled() && !applying) return; return old?.apply(this, args); });
    }
    hook(ctl, 'dropBomb', old => function(entity) {
      if (!controlled() || applying) return old.call(this, entity);
      if (!active()) return false;
      if (entity === g.player && match.carrier === String(S.id)) {
        command('drop'); return true;
      }
      return false;
    });
    freezeSeconds = (ctl.maxMoney || 10000) >= 16000 ? 15 : 5;
    roundSeconds = 115.2;
  }
  function rosterValid() {
    const ids = [String(S.id), ...S.remotes.keys()].filter(Boolean);
    if (ids.length < 2 || ids.length > 10) return 'A match needs 2–10 players.';
    let ct = 0, t = 0;
    for (const id of ids) {
      const p = participants.get(id);
      if (!p || now() - p.at > 2500 || !p.ready) return 'Every player must run Team Play and mark Ready.';
      if (p.mode !== mode() || p.map !== map()) return 'Everyone must enter the same native mode and map.';
      if (p.team === 'CT') ct++; else t++;
    }
    if (!ct || !t || ct > 5 || t > 5) return 'Choose 1–5 players on each team.';
    if (PAGE.clutcherTeamTransport?.report().peers.length !== ids.length - 1) return 'Wait for all player connections to finish negotiating.';
    return '';
  }
  function startMatch() {
    if (!isHost()) return notice('Only the room host starts the match.');
    const problem = rosterValid(); if (problem) return notice(problem);
    bindController(); removeAI();
    N.send({ type: 'room_settings', map: map(), mode: mode() });
    match = { ...match, id: nonce + '-' + (++eventSeq), seq: 0, started: true,
      mode: mode(), map: map(), round: 0, phase: 'lobby', remaining: 0, end: 0,
      score: { CT: 0, T: 0 }, winner: '', reason: '', carrier: '', drop: null, planted: null,
      planter: '', pp: 0, dp: 0, defuser: '', sideEpoch: 0,
      roster: [String(S.id), ...S.remotes.keys()].map(id => [id, participants.get(id).team, 1]) };
    newRound(true); notice('Match started.');
  }
  function newRound(reset = false) {
    if (match.mode === 'defusal' && ctl?.hasHalftime && match.round === Math.floor(ctl.maxRounds / 2)) {
      match.sideEpoch++; [match.score.CT, match.score.T] = [match.score.T, match.score.CT];
      for (const r of match.roster) r[1] = r[1] === 'CT' ? 'T' : 'CT';
    }
    match.round++; match.phase = 'freeze'; match.remaining = match.mode === 'defusal' ? freezeSeconds : 3;
    match.end = 0; match.winner = ''; match.reason = ''; match.carrier = ''; match.drop = null;
    match.planted = null; match.planter = ''; match.pp = match.dp = 0; match.defuser = '';
    const eligible = match.roster.filter(r => r[2] <= match.round && (r[0] === String(S.id) || S.remotes.has(r[0])));
    const terrorists = eligible.filter(r => r[1] === 'T');
    if (match.mode === 'defusal' && terrorists.length) match.carrier = terrorists[(match.round - 1) % terrorists.length][0];
    match.reset = reset || match.sideEpoch > 0 && match.round === Math.floor(ctl?.maxRounds / 2) + 1;
    broadcast(true);
  }
  function finish(winner, reason) {
    if (['end', 'match_end'].includes(match.phase)) return;
    match.winner = winner; match.reason = reason;
    if (winner) match.score[winner]++;
    const target = match.mode === 'defusal' ? Math.floor((ctl?.maxRounds || 15) / 2) + 1 : 1;
    match.phase = winner && match.score[winner] >= target ? 'match_end' : 'end';
    match.end = match.phase === 'match_end' ? 8 : 5; match.pp = match.dp = 0;
    broadcast(true);
  }
  function bombDrop(id) {
    const e = entityFor(id); if (!e || match.carrier !== id || match.planted) return;
    match.carrier = ''; match.drop = [round(e.x), round(e.y + .02), round(e.z), id]; match.dropAt = now(); match.pp = 0;
    broadcast(true);
  }
  function command(action, value) {
    if (!active()) return notice('Enter a game, connect, then join a room first.');
    const packet = ['e', nonce, ++eventSeq, match.id, match.round, action, value ?? null];
    if (isHost()) receiveCommand(String(S.id), packet); else send(packet);
  }
  function receiveCommand(id, packet) {
    if (!isHost() || packet.length !== 7 || !keepEvent(id, packet)) return;
    if (packet[5] === 'pickup-failed' && packet[3] === match.id && packet[4] === match.round) {
      const claim = claimRecords.get(packet[6]);
      if (claim?.owner === id && now() - claim.at < 3000) {
        claimRecords.delete(packet[6]);
        const token = nonce + ':' + (++eventSeq);
        replaying = true; try { makeDrop(token, claim.value); } finally { replaying = false; }
        send(['d', nonce, eventSeq, match.id, match.round, token, claim.value]);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (packet[5] === 'drop' && packet[3] === match.id && packet[4] === match.round && match.carrier === id &&
      ['live', 'freeze'].includes(match.phase)) bombDrop(id);
    if (packet[5] === 'team' && !match.started && ['CT', 'T'].includes(packet[6])) {
      const record = participants.get(id); if (!record) return;
      if ([...participants.values()].filter(p => p.team === packet[6] && now() - p.at < 2500).length >= 5) return;
      record.team = packet[6];
      if (id === String(S.id)) setOwnTeam(packet[6]);
      broadcast(true);
    }
    if (packet[5] === 'pickup' && packet[3] === match.id && packet[4] === match.round &&
      ['freeze', 'live', 'planted'].includes(match.phase)) {
      const token = packet[6], drop = drops.get(token), e = entityFor(id);
      if (!drop || claimedDrops.has(token) || !e?.alive || !dropReach(e, drop, 2.1)) return;
      const rec = participants.get(id);
      if (drop.id === 'defkit' && (e.team !== 'CT' || rec?.kit || !ctl)) return;
      if (grenades.has(drop.id)) {
        const inventory = rec?.grenades || [], count = inventory.find(v => v[0] === drop.id)?.[1] || 0;
        if (inventory.reduce((n, v) => n + v[1], 0) >= 4 || count >= (drop.id === 'flash' ? 2 : 1)) return;
      }
      if (id === String(S.id) && g._canTakeDrop && !g._canTakeDrop(drop)) return;
      const grant = ['x', nonce, ++eventSeq, match.id, match.round, token, 'claim', id, describeDrop(drop)];
      events(String(S.id), grant); send(grant);
    }
  }
  function hostTick(dt) {
    if (!match.started) return;
    if (mode() !== match.mode || map() !== match.map) {
      if (match.phase !== 'match_end') {
        match.phase = 'match_end'; match.end = 0; match.winner = ''; match.reason = 'Host changed map or mode. Start a new match.';
        broadcast(true);
      }
      return;
    }
    match.roster = match.roster.filter(r => r[0] === String(S.id) || S.remotes.has(r[0]));
    for (const [id, rec] of participants) {
      if (!rosterFor(id) && rec.ready && (id === String(S.id) || S.remotes.has(id)) && rec.map === map() && rec.mode === match.mode) {
        const side = rec.team, count = match.roster.filter(r => r[1] === side).length;
        if (count < 5 && match.roster.length < 10) match.roster.push([id, side, match.mode === 'tdm' ? match.round : match.round + 1]);
      }
    }
    if (match.phase === 'freeze') {
      match.remaining = Math.max(0, match.remaining - dt);
      if (!match.remaining) { match.phase = 'live'; match.remaining = match.mode === 'defusal' ? roundSeconds : 600; broadcast(true); }
    } else if (match.phase === 'end' || match.phase === 'match_end') {
      match.end = Math.max(0, match.end - dt);
      if (!match.end && match.phase === 'end') newRound();
    } else if (match.phase === 'live' || match.phase === 'planted') {
      match.remaining -= dt;
      if (match.mode === 'tdm') {
        if (match.remaining <= 0) {
          const scores = { CT: 0, T: 0 };
          for (const r of match.roster) scores[r[1]] += entityFor(r[0])?.kills || 0;
          finish(scores.CT === scores.T ? '' : scores.CT > scores.T ? 'CT' : 'T', 'Time ran out');
        }
        return;
      }
      const live = { CT: [], T: [] };
      for (const r of match.roster) {
        const record = participants.get(r[0]);
        if (r[2] <= match.round && entityFor(r[0])?.alive && record?.map === match.map && record?.mode === match.mode) live[r[1]].push(r[0]);
      }
      if (!live.CT.length) { finish('T', 'Counter-Terrorists eliminated'); return; }
      if (!live.T.length && !match.planted) { finish('CT', 'Terrorists eliminated'); return; }
      if (match.phase === 'live') {
        if (match.remaining <= 0) { finish('CT', 'Time ran out'); return; }
        if (match.carrier && !entityFor(match.carrier)?.alive) bombDrop(match.carrier);
        if (match.drop) {
          for (const id of live.T) {
            const e = entityFor(id), d = match.drop;
            if (id === d[3] && now() - match.dropAt < 1200) continue;
            if (Math.hypot(e.x - d[0], e.z - d[2]) < 1.5 && Math.abs(e.y - d[1]) < 2) {
              match.carrier = id; match.drop = null; broadcast(true); break;
            }
          }
        }
        const e = entityFor(match.carrier), rec = participants.get(match.carrier), site = e && ctl.inSite(e);
        if (e?.alive && e.onGround && site && rec?.use && now() - rec.at < 600 && Math.hypot(e.vx || 0, e.vz || 0) < .25) {
          match.pp += dt / 3.2;
          if (match.pp >= 1) {
            match.planter = match.carrier; match.carrier = ''; match.phase = 'planted'; match.remaining = 40;
            const floor = g.physics.groundHeight?.(e.x, e.y + .5, e.z);
            match.planted = [round(e.x), round(Number.isFinite(floor) && floor > -50 ? floor : e.y), round(e.z), site.name || '?'];
            match.pp = 0; metrics.plants++; broadcast(true);
          }
        } else match.pp = 0;
      } else {
        if (match.remaining <= 0) { metrics.explosions++; finish('T', 'Target destroyed'); return; }
        const eligible = live.CT.filter(id => {
          const e = entityFor(id), rec = participants.get(id);
          return rec?.use && now() - rec.at < 600 && e.onGround && Math.hypot(e.vx || 0, e.vz || 0) < .25 && ctl.bombUseReach(e, true, false);
        });
        const who = eligible.includes(match.defuser) ? match.defuser : eligible[0] || '';
        if (who !== match.defuser) { match.defuser = who; match.dp = 0; }
        if (who) {
          match.dp += dt / (participants.get(who).kit ? 5 : 10);
          if (match.dp >= 1) { metrics.defuses++; finish('CT', 'Bomb defused'); }
        } else match.dp = 0;
      }
    }
  }
  function packetSnapshot(increment = true) {
    return ['b', match.id, increment ? ++match.seq : match.seq, match.mode, match.round, match.phase,
      round(match.remaining), round(match.end), match.score.CT, match.score.T, match.winner, match.reason,
      match.carrier, match.drop, match.planted, match.planter, round(match.pp), match.defuser, round(match.dp),
      match.roster, match.sideEpoch, !!match.reset, match.started ? match.map : map()];
  }
  function broadcast(force = false) {
    if (!isHost() || !active() || !force && now() - lastSnapshot < (match.pp || match.dp ? 150 : 500)) return;
    const packet = packetSnapshot(); applySnapshot(String(S.id), packet); send(packet); lastSnapshot = now();
    N.send({ type: 'match_meta', phase: match.phase, round: match.round });
  }
  function applySnapshot(id, p) {
    if (id !== host() || p.length !== 23 || typeof p[1] !== 'string' || p[1].length > 64 || typeof p[22] !== 'string' || p[22].length > 40 || !['defusal', 'tdm'].includes(p[3]) ||
      !['lobby', 'freeze', 'live', 'planted', 'end', 'match_end'].includes(p[5]) ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(p[2]) || !Number.isSafeInteger(p[4]) || !Array.isArray(p[19]) || p[19].length > 10 ||
      p[19].some(r => !Array.isArray(r) || r.length !== 3 || typeof r[0] !== 'string' || r[0].length > 80 || !['CT', 'T'].includes(r[1]) || !Number.isSafeInteger(r[2])) ||
      new Set(p[19].map(r => r[0])).size !== p[19].length ||
      [p[13], p[14]].some(v => v !== null && (!Array.isArray(v) || v.length !== 4 || !v.slice(0, 3).every(Number.isFinite) || typeof v[3] !== 'string')) ||
      ![p[6], p[7], p[8], p[9], p[16], p[18]].every(Number.isFinite)) { metrics.rejected++; return; }
    if (match.id === p[1] && p[2] < match.seq) return;
    if (!isHost()) match = { ...match, id: p[1], seq: p[2], started: !!p[1], mode: p[3], round: p[4], phase: p[5],
      remaining: Math.max(0, Math.min(600, num(p[6]))), end: Math.max(0, Math.min(10, num(p[7]))),
      score: { CT: p[8] | 0, T: p[9] | 0 }, winner: p[10], reason: String(p[11]).slice(0, 80),
      carrier: p[12], drop: p[13], planted: p[14], planter: p[15], pp: num(p[16]), defuser: p[17], dp: num(p[18]),
      roster: p[19], sideEpoch: p[20] | 0, reset: !!p[21], map: p[22] };
    lastReceived = now(); bindController();
    const own = rosterFor(S.id); if (own) setOwnTeam(own[1]);
    for (const remote of S.remotes.values()) correctModel(remote);
    if (!match.started || mode() !== match.mode || map() !== match.map) { g.frozen = true; return; }
    const key = match.id + ':' + match.round;
    applying = true;
    try {
      if (lastRound !== key) {
        const newMatch = lastMatch !== match.id; lastMatch = match.id;
        lastRound = key; lastPlant = lastDrop = lastEnd = ''; metrics.rounds++;
        if (newMatch) {
          for (const name of ['kills', 'deaths', 'assists', '_hsKills', '_dmgDealt', '_roundDmg', '_mvps', '_udDmg', '_efCount']) g.player[name] = 0;
          g.player._dmgBy = null;
          if (ctl) { ctl.roundLog = []; ctl.lossStreak = { CT: 0, T: 0 }; ctl.lastWinner = null; }
        }
        if (match.reset) {
          g.player.money = (ctl?.maxMoney || 10000) >= 16000 ? 800 : 1000;
          if (ctl) { ctl.playerSurvived = false; ctl.lossStreak = { CT: 0, T: 0 }; }
        }
        removeAI();
        if (ctl) {
          ctl.roundNum = match.round - 1; ctlNative.nextRound.call(ctl);
          freezeSeconds = Math.max(1, num(ctl.freezeT, freezeSeconds));
          roundSeconds = Math.max(30, num(ctl.roundClock, roundSeconds));
        }
        else native.start.call(g);
        const index = Math.max(0, match.roster.filter(r => r[1] === g.player.team).findIndex(r => r[0] === String(S.id)));
        const spawns = g.player.team === 'CT' ? g.map.spawnsCT : g.map.spawnsT;
        if (spawns?.length) g.player.spawnAt(spawns[index % spawns.length]);
        g.hud.hideDeath?.(); g._clearDeathCam?.(); g.spectating = null; clearScope();
        drops.clear(); claimedDrops.clear(); pendingPickups.clear(); seenEvents.clear();
        brokenProps.clear(); lifeStates.clear(); killfeed.length = 0; feedKeys.clear(); claimRecords.clear(); lastWorld = -Infinity;
        admissionKey = own && own[2] <= match.round ? key : '';
      }
      if (!own || own[2] > match.round) { g.player.alive = false; g.hud.showRespawn?.(null); }
      else if (match.mode === 'tdm' && admissionKey !== key) {
        admissionKey = key;
        if (g.respawnPlayer) g.respawnPlayer();
        else { const spawns = own[1] === 'CT' ? g.map.spawnsCT : g.map.spawnsT; if (spawns?.length) g.player.spawnAt(spawns[0]); }
        clearScope(); g.hud.hideDeath?.();
      }
      g.roundActive = ['freeze', 'live', 'planted'].includes(match.phase);
      g.frozen = match.phase === 'freeze'; g.respawnAllowed = match.mode === 'tdm';
      g.roundTimeLeft = match.remaining; g.endT = match.end;
      if (ctl) {
        if (match.planted) {
          const plantKey = key + ':' + match.planted.join(',');
          if (lastPlant !== plantKey) {
            lastPlant = plantKey;
            const planter = entityFor(match.planter) || { x: match.planted[0], y: match.planted[1], z: match.planted[2], isPlayer: false, money: 0, team: 'T' };
            ctlNative.plant.call(ctl, planter, { name: match.planted[3] });
          }
          if (ctl.planted) {
            Object.assign(ctl.planted, { x: match.planted[0], y: match.planted[1], z: match.planted[2] });
            ctl.bombMesh?.position?.set(match.planted[0], match.planted[1] + .02, match.planted[2]);
          }
        } else if (ctl.planted) { ctlNative.cleanupBomb.call(ctl); lastPlant = ''; }
        if (match.drop) {
          const dropKey = key + ':' + match.drop.join(',');
          if (lastDrop !== dropKey) {
            if (ctl.dropped?.mesh) g.scene.remove(ctl.dropped.mesh);
            ctlNative._tossBomb.call(ctl, match.drop[0], match.drop[1], match.drop[2], 0, 0, entityFor(match.drop[3]));
            if (ctl.dropped) { ctl.dropped.vx = ctl.dropped.vy = ctl.dropped.vz = 0; ctl.dropped.settled = true; }
            lastDrop = dropKey;
          }
        } else { if (ctl.dropped?.mesh) g.scene.remove(ctl.dropped.mesh); ctl.dropped = null; lastDrop = ''; }
        ctl.carrier = entityFor(match.carrier) || null;
        ctl.defuser = entityFor(match.defuser) || null; ctl._planting = match.pp > 0 ? ctl.carrier : null;
        ctl._defusing = match.dp > 0 ? ctl.defuser : null; ctl.plantProgress = match.pp; ctl.defuseProgress = match.dp;
        for (const remote of S.remotes.values()) if (remote.bot) remote.bot.hasBomb = remote.id === match.carrier;
        if (match.carrier === String(S.id)) {
          g.weapons.slots[5] = 'c4'; g.weapons.states.c4 ||= { ammo: 1, reserve: 0 };
        } else if (g.weapons.slots[5] === 'c4') {
          g.weapons.slots[5] = null;
          if (g.weapons.current === 'c4') g.weapons.equip(g.weapons.slots[1] || g.weapons.slots[2] || 'knife');
        }
        if (['end', 'match_end'].includes(match.phase) && lastEnd !== key) {
          lastEnd = key;
          // Use native local payouts, announcements and explosion effects once.
          if (match.reason === 'Target destroyed' && ctl.planted) ctlNative.explode.call(ctl);
          else if (match.winner) ctlNative.roundEnd.call(ctl, match.winner, match.reason);
          else { ctlNative.cleanupBomb.call(ctl); g.roundActive = false; }
          if (match.reason === 'Bomb defused' && match.defuser === String(S.id)) {
            g.player.money = Math.min(ctl.maxMoney || 10000, g.player.money + ((ctl.maxMoney || 10000) >= 16000 ? 300 : 200));
          }
          if (match.reason === 'Bomb defused') {
            g.audio?.play?.('defused', { pos: ctl.planted }); g.effects?.bombLightOff?.(); ctl._announceDefused?.();
          }
          g.hud.scoreOpen = false; g.hud.forceScoreT = 0; g.hud.updateScoreboard?.(false);
        }
        ctl.state = match.phase === 'lobby' ? 'freeze' : match.phase;
        ctl.freezeT = match.phase === 'freeze' ? match.remaining : 0;
        ctl.roundClock = match.phase === 'live' ? match.remaining : ctl.roundClock;
        ctl.bombT = match.phase === 'planted' ? match.remaining : 0;
        ctl.endT = match.end; ctl.roundNum = match.round; ctl.score = { ...match.score };
      } else if (['end', 'match_end'].includes(match.phase) && lastEnd !== key) { lastEnd = key; native.end.call(g); }
    } finally { applying = false; }
  }

  function bindWorldSystems() {

      boundSystems.add(manager); native.throwFrom = manager.throwFrom;
      if (typeof manager.throwFrom === 'function') worldRestores.grenades.push(hook(manager, 'throwFrom', old => function(owner, id, ...values) {

      }));

      (props.ents || []).forEach((ent, index) => propIndexes.set(ent, index));
      if (typeof props._break === 'function') worldRestores.props.push(hook(props, '_break', old => function(ent, dx = 0, dy = 0, dz = 0, blast = null) {

          if (Number.isInteger(index)) {
            brokenProps.set(index, signature);
            send(['p', nonce, ++eventSeq, match.id, match.round, index, signature, [round(dx), round(dy), round(dz)]]);
          }
        }
        return result;
      }));
    }
  }
  function propSignature(ent) {
    return String(ent?.d?.model || '') + ':' + (ent?.d?.center || []).map(round).join(',');
  }
  function breakProp(index, signature, direction = [0, 0, 0]) {

    brokenProps.set(index, signature);
    if (!ent.broken) { g.mapEnts._break(ent, ...direction); metrics.propsSynced++; }
  }

  function clearScope() {

  function confirmedStatus(id, packet) {
    if (!active() || !match.started || packet[7] !== map() || packet[11] !== match.id + ':' + match.round || typeof packet[3] !== 'boolean' ||
      !/^[a-f0-9]{12}$/.test(packet[1]) || !Number.isSafeInteger(packet[2])) return;
    const before = lifeStates.get(id), key = id + ':' + packet[1] + ':' + packet[2];

    lifeStates.set(id, { session: packet[1], life: packet[2], alive: packet[3],statusSequence:packet[12]||0 });

    const playerName = who => who === String(S.id) ? S.name : S.remotes.get(who)?.name || who || 'World';
    killfeed.push({ key, killer: playerName(killerId), victim: playerName(id), weapon: String(attacker?.[2] || 'world'), head: !!attacker?.[1], at: now() });
    if (killfeed.length > 6) killfeed.shift(); metrics.killfeedEvents++;

  }

  if (native.spawnDrop) hook(g, 'spawnDrop', old => function(x, y, z, id, skin, ammo, reserve, velocity, item, ...tail) {

    }

  function settleDrop(drop) {
    drop.q?.identity?.(); drop.mesh?.quaternion?.identity?.(); drop.w?.set?.(0, 0, 0);
    const floor = g.physics.groundHeight?.(drop.x, drop.y + .5, drop.z);
    if (Number.isFinite(floor) && floor > -50) drop.y = round(floor + .025 + num(drop.shape?.he?.y, .06) - num(drop.shape?.c?.y));
    drop.settled = true; drop.vx = drop.vy = drop.vz = 0;
    drop.mesh?.position?.set(drop.x, drop.y, drop.z);
    drop.shadow?.position?.set(drop.x, Number.isFinite(floor) ? floor + .015 : drop.y, drop.z);
    if (drop.shadow) drop.shadow.visible = true;
  }
  function describeDrop(drop) {
    // Keep finish metadata small; never transmit images, meshes or inventory IDs.
    const skin = drop.skin && typeof drop.skin === 'object' ? Object.fromEntries(
      ['id', 'name', 'weapon', 'kit', 'wmin', 'wmax'].filter(k => ['string', 'number'].includes(typeof drop.skin[k])).map(k => [k, drop.skin[k]])) : null;
    const item = drop.item && { wear: num(drop.item.wear), seed: num(drop.item.seed) };
    return [round(drop.x), round(drop.y), round(drop.z), drop.id, drop.ammo ?? null, drop.reserve ?? null, skin, item];
  }
  function validDrop(value) {
    return Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 8 && value.slice(0, 3).every(Number.isFinite) && weaponIds.has(value[3]) &&
      value.slice(4, 6).every(v => v === null || Number.isFinite(v) && v >= 0 && v <= 10000) && JSON.stringify(value).length <= 1400;
  }
  function makeDrop(token, value) {
    if (!validDrop(value) || typeof token !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{12}:\d+$/.test(token)) return null;
    if (claimedDrops.has(token)) return null;
    if (drops.has(token)) { metrics.duplicateDrops++; return drops.get(token); }
    const previous = g.drops?.at(-1);
    const existing = g.drops; g.drops = [];
    try { native.spawnDrop?.call(g, value[0], value[1], value[2], value[3], value[6], value[4], value[5], null, value[7]); }
    finally { const created = g.drops; g.drops = existing; g.drops.push(...created); }
    const drop = g.drops?.at(-1);
    if (!drop || drop === previous) return null;
    drop.__teamDrop = token; drops.set(token, drop); settleDrop(drop); return drop;
  }
  function requestPickup(drop) {
    if (!drop?.__teamDrop || !g.player.alive || !dropReach(g.player, drop, 2.1) || g._canTakeDrop && !g._canTakeDrop(drop) || now() - (pendingPickups.get(drop.__teamDrop) || -Infinity) < 500) return false;
    pendingPickups.set(drop.__teamDrop, now()); command('pickup', drop.__teamDrop); return true;
  }
  if (native.takeDrop) hook(g, '_takeDrop', old => function(drop) {
    if (controlled() && match.started && drop?.__teamDrop && !replaying) return active() && requestPickup(drop);
    return old.call(this, drop);
  });
  function dropBounds(drop) {
    return { x: drop.x + num(drop.shape?.c?.x), y: drop.y + num(drop.shape?.c?.y, .06), z: drop.z + num(drop.shape?.c?.z),
      hx: Math.max(.18, num(drop.shape?.he?.x, .3)), hy: Math.max(.15, num(drop.shape?.he?.y, .06)), hz: Math.max(.18, num(drop.shape?.he?.z, .3)) };
  }
  function dropReach(entity, drop, reach) {
    const box = dropBounds(drop), cy = box.y, dx = box.x - entity.x, dz = box.z - entity.z;
    if (Math.hypot(Math.max(0, Math.abs(dx) - box.hx), Math.max(0, Math.abs(dz) - box.hz)) > reach || cy - box.hy > entity.y + 1.9 || cy + box.hy < entity.y - .65) return false;
    const eyeY = entity.y + num(entity.eyeH, 1.6) - num(entity._stepLift), dy = cy - eyeY, distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);
    if (distance < .01) return true;
    const wall = g.physics.raycast?.(entity.x, eyeY, entity.z, dx / distance, dy / distance, dz / distance, distance, 2);
    return !wall || !Number.isFinite(wall.t) || wall.t >= distance - .2;
  }
  hook(g, '_useDropTarget', old => function(...args) {
    if (!controlled() || !match.started) return old?.apply(this, args);
    const p = g.player; if (!p.alive) return null;
    const cosine = Math.cos(p.pitch || 0), direction = [-Math.sin(p.yaw || 0) * cosine, Math.sin(p.pitch || 0), -Math.cos(p.yaw || 0) * cosine];
    let selected = null, best = Infinity;
    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
      if (!dropReach(p, drop, 2.1)) continue;
      const box = dropBounds(drop), origin = [p.x, p.y + num(p.eyeH, 1.6) - num(p._stepLift), p.z];
      const center = [box.x, box.y, box.z], half = [box.hx + .12, box.hy + .12, box.hz + .12];
      let near = 0, far = 4;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        if (Math.abs(direction[i]) < 1e-8) { if (Math.abs(origin[i] - center[i]) > half[i]) { far = -1; break; } continue; }
        const a = (center[i] - half[i] - origin[i]) / direction[i], b = (center[i] + half[i] - origin[i]) / direction[i];
        near = Math.max(near, Math.min(a, b)); far = Math.min(far, Math.max(a, b));
      }
      if (far >= near && near < best) { best = near; selected = drop; }
    }
    if (selected) return selected;
    return this._touchDrop && this.time - num(this._touchDropT, -9) < .2 && drops.has(this._touchDrop.__teamDrop) ? this._touchDrop : null;
  });
  if (typeof g.updateDrops === 'function') hook(g, 'updateDrops', old => function(dt) {
    if (!controlled() || !match.started) return old.call(this, dt);
    const alive = g.player.alive;
    // Synchronized drops have deterministic poses and host-controlled expiry.
    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
      if (drop.proc && this._upgradeDropModel) { this._upgradeDropModel(drop); settleDrop(drop); }
    }
    if (!alive || !active()) return;
    for (const drop of [...drops.values()].sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - g.player.x, a.z - g.player.z) - Math.hypot(b.x - g.player.x, b.z - g.player.z))) {
      if (!drop.settled || !dropReach(g.player, drop, .85)) continue;
      if (drop.id === 'defkit' ? g.player.team === 'CT' && !ctl?.playerKit : grenades.has(drop.id) ? g.weapons.grenadeRoom?.(drop.id) : !g.weapons.slots[pistols.has(drop.id) ? 2 : 1]) requestPickup(drop);
      else { g._touchDrop = drop; g._touchDropT = g.time; }
      break;
    }
  });
  function events(id, packet) {
    if (packet[3] !== match.id || packet[4] !== match.round || !match.started || map() !== match.map || mode() !== match.mode || !keepEvent(id, packet)) return;
    replaying = true;
    try {
      if (packet[0] === 'g' && grenades.has(packet[5]) && ['live', 'planted'].includes(match.phase) &&
        Array.isArray(packet[6]) && packet[6].length >= 6 && packet[6].length <= 7 && packet[6].every(Number.isFinite)) {
        const owner = entityFor(id); if (owner?.alive) native.throwFrom?.call(g.grenadeMgr, owner, packet[5], ...packet[6]);
      } else if (packet[0] === 'p' && packet.length === 8 && Number.isInteger(packet[5]) && packet[5] >= 0 && typeof packet[6] === 'string' && packet[6].length < 160 && Array.isArray(packet[7]) && packet[7].length === 3 && packet[7].every(Number.isFinite)) {
        breakProp(packet[5], packet[6], packet[7]);
      } else if (packet[0] === 'd' && packet.length === 7 && typeof packet[5] === 'string' && packet[5].startsWith(packet[1] + ':') && !claimedDrops.has(packet[5])) {
        makeDrop(packet[5], packet[6]);
      } else if (packet[0] === 'x') {
        const token = packet[5];
        if (id !== host()) return;
        if (packet[6] === 'claim') {
          if (claimedDrops.has(token) || !validDrop(packet[8])) return;
          claimRecords.set(token, { owner: packet[7], value: packet[8], at: now() });
          if (packet[7] === String(S.id) && g.player.alive) {
            const drop = drops.get(token) || makeDrop(token, packet[8]);
            // A swapped-out weapon is a new local drop and must be broadcast.
            replaying = false;
            try {
              if (drop && native.takeDrop?.call(g, drop)) metrics.pickups++;
              else command('pickup-failed', token);
            } finally { replaying = true; }
          }
        }
        claimedDrops.set(token, now());
        const drop = drops.get(token);
        if (drop) {
          g.scene?.remove?.(drop.mesh); g.scene?.remove?.(drop.shadow);
          const index = g.drops.indexOf(drop); if (index >= 0) g.drops.splice(index, 1); drops.delete(token);
        }
        pendingPickups.delete(token);
      }
    } finally { replaying = false; }
  }
  function dropTick() {
    if (isHost()) for (const [token, drop] of drops) if (!g.drops?.includes(drop) || !ctl && g.time - num(drop.born, g.time) > 15 || drops.size > 32) {
      const packet = ['x', nonce, ++eventSeq, match.id, match.round, token, 'expire']; events(String(S.id), packet); send(packet);
    }
    for (const [key, at] of pendingPickups) if (now() - at > 1000) pendingPickups.delete(key);
    if (claimedDrops.size > 256) claimedDrops.delete(claimedDrops.keys().next().value);
    for (const [token, claim] of claimRecords) if (now() - claim.at > 3000) claimRecords.delete(token);
  }
  function worldSnapshot(target = '') {
    if (!active() || !isHost() || !match.started) return;
    const props = [...brokenProps], weapons = [...drops].map(([token, drop]) => [token, describeDrop(drop)]), removed = [...claimedDrops.keys()];
    const make = () => ['z', nonce, ++eventSeq, match.id, match.round, target, [], [], []];
    let packet = make();
    const flush = () => { if (packet.slice(6).some(a => a.length)) send(packet); packet = make(); };
    for (const [index, entries, limit] of [[6, props, 32], [7, weapons, 4], [8, removed, 32]]) for (const entry of entries) {
      if (packet[index].length >= limit) flush();
      packet[index].push(entry);
      if (JSON.stringify(packet).length > 7900) { packet[index].pop(); flush(); packet[index].push(entry); }
    }
    flush();
  }
  function receiveWorld(id, packet) {
    if (id !== host() || packet.length !== 9 || packet[3] !== match.id || packet[4] !== match.round || packet[5] && packet[5] !== String(S.id) || !match.started || !keepEvent(id, packet)) return;
    if (![packet[6], packet[7], packet[8]].every(Array.isArray) || packet[6].length > 32 || packet[7].length > 4 || packet[8].length > 32) return;
    replaying = true;
    try {
      for (const token of packet[8]) if (typeof token === 'string' && /^[a-f0-9]{12}:\d+$/.test(token)) {
        claimedDrops.set(token, now()); const drop = drops.get(token);
        if (drop) { g.scene.remove(drop.mesh); g.scene.remove(drop.shadow); const at = g.drops.indexOf(drop); if (at >= 0) g.drops.splice(at, 1); drops.delete(token); }
      }
      for (const entry of packet[6]) if (Array.isArray(entry) && Number.isInteger(entry[0]) && typeof entry[1] === 'string') breakProp(entry[0], entry[1]);
      for (const entry of packet[7]) if (Array.isArray(entry) && entry.length === 2) makeDrop(entry[0], entry[1]);
    } finally { replaying = false; }
  }
  function updateAvatars() {

      const image = row.el?.querySelector?.('.pid-AvatarImage'); if (!image) continue;
      image.dataset.teamOriginalSrc ||= image.getAttribute('src') || '';
      const source = value || image.dataset.teamOriginalSrc;
      if (image.getAttribute('src') !== source) image.setAttribute('src', source);
    }
  }

  hook(g.hud, 'playerName', old => function(...args) { return S.room ? String(S.name || 'Player').replace(/[<>&"']/g, '') : old?.apply(this, args); });
  async function loadRoomMap() {
    if (joiningMap) return;
    const settings = match.started ? match : S.roomData;
    if (!settings?.map || !['tdm', 'defusal'].includes(settings.mode)) return notice('The room has no map details yet. Ask its host to create it with v2.');
    if (settings.map === map() && settings.mode === mode()) return notice('You are already on the room map and mode.');
    if (!g.startGame || !g.finishTeamSelect) return notice('This game build does not expose the map loading controls.');
    joiningMap = true; PAGE.__clutcherTeamMapLoading = true; ready = false; lastUser = -Infinity; applying = true;
    const members = [...S.remotes.values()].map(r => ({ id: r.id, name: r.name, team: r.team, avatar: r.avatar, avatarEnabled: r.avatarEnabled }));
    const myRoom = String(S.room), side = rosterFor(S.id)?.[1] || team(g.player.team);
    try {
      notice('Loading ' + settings.map + ' · ' + settings.mode + '…');
      B.clear(); g.hud.hidePause?.(); clearScope();
      const loaded = await g.startGame(settings.map, 0, 0, settings.mode === 'tdm' ? 'dm' : 'defusal');
      if (loaded === false || g.state !== 'teamselect') throw new Error('The native map loader did not finish.');
      await g.finishTeamSelect(side);
      if (g.state !== 'playing') throw new Error('The native match did not start.');
      if (stopped || String(S.room) !== myRoom) return;
      bindController(); bindWorldSystems(); U.confirmMatch(); removeAI();
      for (const member of members) B.receive(member);
      lastRound = lastPlant = lastDrop = lastEnd = ''; brokenProps.clear(); drops.clear();
      N.send({ type: 'join_room', roomId: S.room });
      if (match.started && settings.map === map() && settings.mode === mode()) applySnapshot(host(), packetSnapshot(false));
      lastWorld = -Infinity;
      notice('Room map loaded. Mark ready; joining a running defuse match enters next round.');
    } catch (error) { metrics.errors++; notice('Map loading failed: ' + error.message); }
    finally { applying = false; joiningMap = false; delete PAGE.__clutcherTeamMapLoading; S.outsideMatchSince = 0; }
  }
  async function avatarFile(file) {
    if (!file) return;
    if (!/^image\//.test(file.type) || file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) return notice('Choose an image smaller than 5 MB.');
    try {
      const bitmap = await PAGE.createImageBitmap(file), canvas = PAGE.document.createElement('canvas'); canvas.width = canvas.height = 96;
      const size = Math.min(bitmap.width, bitmap.height);
      canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(bitmap, (bitmap.width - size) / 2, (bitmap.height - size) / 2, size, size, 0, 0, 96, 96); bitmap.close();
      const value = canvas.toDataURL('image/webp', .75);
      if (value.length > 60000) throw new Error('Avatar is too large after compression.');
      S.avatar = value; S.avatarEnabled = true; S.avatarDirty = true;
      try { PAGE.localStorage.setItem('pp-avatar', value); PAGE.localStorage.setItem('pp-avatar-on', 'true'); } catch {}
      updateAvatars(); notice('Avatar updated.');
    } catch (error) { notice('Could not load avatar: ' + error.message); }

  (function installClutcherTeamTransport(PAGE) {
  'use strict';

  const BASE = '~CTM3~', SIGNAL = '~CTR3~';
  const originalSend = N.send, originalHandle = N.handle;
  const links = new Map(), restores = [], queue = [];
  const counters = { directSent: 0, relaySent: 0, received: 0, retries: 0,
    duplicates: 0, rejected: 0, botsRemoved: 0 };
  const now = () => PAGE.performance.now();
  const numTime = value => Number.isFinite(value) ? value : -Infinity;
  const random = () => Array.from(PAGE.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(6)),
    b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
  let session = random(), room = null, transfer = 0, stopped = false;
  let lastHello = -Infinity, lastBadge = 0, lastCleanup = 0;
  const active = () => !stopped && S.connected && S.confirmedMatch && !!S.room &&
    game.state === 'playing';
  const validSession = x => typeof x === 'string' && /^[a-f0-9]{12}$/.test(x);
  const log = message => PAGE.console.log('[Team Transport]', message);
  function hook(object, key, replacement) {
    const own = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(object, key), old = object[key];
    object[key] = replacement;
    restores.push(() => {
      if (object[key] !== replacement) return;
      if (own) object[key] = old; else delete object[key];
    });
  }
  function metric(peer, key, value) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0 || value > 30000) return;
    const values = peer.metrics[key] ||= [];
    values.push(Math.round(value)); if (values.length > 12) values.shift();
  }
  function median(values) {
    if (!values?.length) return null;
    const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    return sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)];
  }
  function relayRaw(packet) {
    if (!active() || (S.ws?.bufferedAmount || 0) > 65536) return false;
    const message = SIGNAL + JSON.stringify(packet);
    if (message.length > 8192) { counters.rejected++; return false; }
    return !!originalSend.call(N, { type: 'chat', message });
  }
  function fragments(peer, payload, urgent = false) {
    if (!active() || !links.has(peer.id)) return false;
    const text = JSON.stringify(payload);
    if (text.length > 32768) return false;
    const id = (++transfer).toString(36);
    let size = peer.largeFrames ? 6000 : 96, frames;
    do {
      const count = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(text.length / size));
      frames = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ['f', String(S.room),
        peer.id, session, id, i, count, text.slice(i * size, (i + 1) * size)]);
      if (frames.every(f => SIGNAL.length + JSON.stringify(f).length <= (peer.largeFrames ? 8192 : 300))) break;
      size = Math.floor(size / 2);
    } while (size >= 12);
    if (size < 12 || frames.length > 384 || queue.length + frames.length > 4096) return false;
    const created = now();
    for (const frame of frames) queue.push({ frame, created, urgent });
    if (urgent) pump();
    return true;
  }
  function pump() {
    if (!active()) return;
    for (let n = 0; n < 24 && queue.length; n++) {
      let index = queue.findIndex(x => x.urgent); if (index < 0) index = 0;
      const item = queue[index];
      if (now() - item.created > 10000 || item.frame[1] !== String(S.room)) {
        queue.splice(index, 1); continue;
      }
      if (!relayRaw(item.frame)) return;
      queue.splice(index, 1);
    }
  }
  function sendControl(peer, packet, route) {
    if (route === 'direct' && peer.channel?.readyState === 'open' &&
      peer.channel.bufferedAmount <= 32768) {
      try { peer.channel.send(JSON.stringify(packet)); return 'direct'; } catch {}
    }
    return fragments(peer, packet, true) ? 'relay' : false;
  }
  function closeConnection(peer) {
    peer.closed = true;
    try { peer.channel?.close(); } catch {}
    try { peer.pc?.close(); } catch {}
    peer.channel = null; peer.pc = null;
  }
  function closeAll() {
    for (const peer of links.values()) closeConnection(peer);
    links.clear(); queue.length = 0;
  }
  function syncRoom() {
    if (room === S.room) return;
    closeAll(); room = S.room; session = random();
    lastHello = -Infinity; lastCleanup = 0;
  }
  function makeLink(id, remoteSession) {
    const existing = links.get(id);
    if (existing?.session === remoteSession) return existing;
    if (existing) closeConnection(existing);
    // At most nine remote connections; ten participants total.
    if (!existing && links.size >= 9) return null;
    const peer = { id, session: remoteSession, pc: null, channel: null,
      connectionId: null, closed: false, attempts: 0, started: 0,
      retryAt: 0, lastSeen: now(), lastPing: -Infinity,
      nextOut: 1, nextIn: 1, latestOut:0,latestIn:{},latest:false,largeFrames:false, outbox: new Map(), inbox: new Map(),
      applied: new Map(), assemblies: new Map(), ice: new Map(), pings: new Map(),
      metrics: {}, hitRtt: null, candidates: null, lastError: null,
      chain: Promise.resolve() };
    links.set(id, peer); return peer;
  }
  function updateCandidates(peer) {
    const pc = peer.pc;
    if (!pc?.getStats) return;
    pc.getStats().then(stats => {
      if (peer.pc !== pc || stopped) return;
      let pair;
      for (const stat of stats.values()) {
        if (stat.type === 'transport' && stat.selectedCandidatePairId) pair = stats.get(stat.selectedCandidatePairId);
      }
      if (!pair) for (const stat of stats.values()) {
        if (stat.type === 'candidate-pair' && stat.state === 'succeeded' && stat.nominated) { pair = stat; break; }
      }
      if (!pair) return;
      const local = stats.get(pair.localCandidateId), remote = stats.get(pair.remoteCandidateId);
      peer.candidates = { local: local?.candidateType, remote: remote?.candidateType,
        protocol: local?.protocol };
    }).catch(() => {});
  }
  function bindChannel(peer, channel) {
    peer.channel = channel;
    channel.onopen = () => {
      if (stopped || peer.closed || links.get(peer.id) !== peer || peer.channel !== channel) return;
      log('Direct connection open with ' + peer.id + '.');
      updateCandidates(peer);
      // Retransmit unresolved data through the newly opened reliable channel.
      for (const flight of peer.outbox.values()) transmit(peer, flight, 'direct');
    };
    channel.onmessage = event => {
      if (typeof event.data !== 'string' || event.data.length > 16384 ||
        stopped || peer.closed || links.get(peer.id) !== peer) return;
      try { dispatch(peer, JSON.parse(event.data), 'direct'); }
      catch { counters.rejected++; }
    };
    channel.onclose = () => { if (!stopped && !peer.closed) peer.lastError = 'Direct channel closed; relay fallback.'; };
    channel.onerror = () => { peer.lastError = 'Data channel error; relay fallback.'; };
  }
  function createConnection(peer, connectionId, offerer) {
    if (typeof PAGE.RTCPeerConnection !== 'function') {
      peer.lastError = 'WebRTC unavailable; relay only.'; return null;
    }
    if (peer.pc) closeConnection(peer);
    peer.closed = false; peer.started = now(); peer.connectionId = connectionId;
    const pc = new PAGE.RTCPeerConnection({
      iceServers: [{ urls: 'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302' }],
      bundlePolicy: 'max-bundle'
    });
    peer.pc = pc;
    pc.onicecandidate = event => {
      if (event.candidate && peer.pc === pc && !peer.closed && active()) {
        fragments(peer, ['ice', session, connectionId, event.candidate.toJSON()]);
      }
    };
    pc.ondatachannel = event => {
      if (peer.pc === pc && event.channel.label === 'clutcher-team-v3') bindChannel(peer, event.channel);
      else event.channel.close();
    };
    pc.onconnectionstatechange = () => {
      if (peer.pc !== pc) return;
      if (pc.connectionState === 'failed') {
        peer.lastError = 'Direct connection failed; relay fallback.';
        closeConnection(peer); peer.retryAt = now() + 10000;
      }
    };
    if (offerer) bindChannel(peer, pc.createDataChannel('clutcher-team-v3', { ordered: true }));
    return pc;
  }
  async function startOffer(peer) {
    if (!active() || peer.pc || String(S.id) >= peer.id || peer.attempts >= 3 || now() < peer.retryAt) return;
    peer.attempts++;
    const connectionId = session + '-' + peer.attempts;
    try {
      const pc = createConnection(peer, connectionId, true); if (!pc) return;
      await pc.setLocalDescription(await pc.createOffer());
      if (peer.pc !== pc || !active()) return;
      fragments(peer, ['offer', session, connectionId, { type: 'offer', sdp: pc.localDescription.sdp }]);
    } catch (error) {
      peer.lastError = error.message; closeConnection(peer); peer.retryAt = now() + 10000;
    }
  }
  async function drainIce(peer) {
    const pc = peer.pc;
    if (!pc?.remoteDescription) return;
    const candidates = peer.ice.get(peer.connectionId) || [];
    peer.ice.delete(peer.connectionId);
    for (const candidate of candidates) {
      if (peer.pc !== pc) return;
      try { await pc.addIceCandidate(candidate); } catch (error) { peer.lastError = error.message; }
    }
  }
  async function signal(peer, packet) {
    if (!active() || links.get(peer.id) !== peer) return;
    const [kind, remoteSession, connectionId, value] = packet;
    if (remoteSession !== peer.session || typeof connectionId !== 'string' || connectionId.length > 32) return;
    if (kind === 'offer') {
      if (peer.id >= String(S.id) || value?.type !== 'offer' || typeof value.sdp !== 'string') return;
      if (peer.pc && peer.connectionId === connectionId) return;
      const pc = createConnection(peer, connectionId, false); if (!pc) return;
      await pc.setRemoteDescription(value); await drainIce(peer);
      if (peer.pc !== pc || !active()) return;
      await pc.setLocalDescription(await pc.createAnswer());
      if (peer.pc !== pc || !active()) return;
      fragments(peer, ['answer', session, connectionId, { type: 'answer', sdp: pc.localDescription.sdp }]);
    } else if (kind === 'answer') {
      if (connectionId !== peer.connectionId || !peer.pc || value?.type !== 'answer' || typeof value.sdp !== 'string') return;
      if (!peer.pc.remoteDescription) await peer.pc.setRemoteDescription(value);
      await drainIce(peer);
    } else if (kind === 'ice' && value && typeof value.candidate === 'string') {
      if (!peer.ice.has(connectionId) && peer.ice.size >= 3) return;
      const list = peer.ice.get(connectionId) || [];
      if (list.length >= 32) return;
      list.push(value); peer.ice.set(connectionId, list);
      await drainIce(peer);
    }
  }
  function transmit(peer, flight, route) {
    const packet = ['d', session, flight.sequence, flight.packet];
    const actual = sendControl(peer, packet, route);
    if (!actual) return false;
    flight.lastTry = now(); flight.tries++;
    if (!flight.firstRoute) flight.firstRoute = actual;
    if (actual === 'direct') counters.directSent++; else counters.relaySent++;
    return true;
  }
  function sendApp(peer, packet) {
    if(!peer.latest && packet[0]==='s') {
      const signature=JSON.stringify(packet.slice(0,12));
      if(signature===peer.legacyStatus&&now()-numTime(peer.legacyStatusAt)<750)return true;
      peer.legacyStatus=signature;peer.legacyStatusAt=now();
    }
    const criticalStatus = packet[0]==='s' && peer.lifeState !== packet[1]+':'+packet[2]+':'+packet[3];
    if(packet[0]==='s')peer.lifeState=packet[1]+':'+packet[2]+':'+packet[3];
    if(peer.latest && !criticalStatus && ['s','u','b'].includes(packet[0])) {
      const frame=['v',session,++peer.latestOut,packet];
      return !!sendControl(peer,frame,peer.channel?.readyState==='open'?'direct':'relay');
    }
    if (peer.outbox.size >= 128) return false;
    const flight = { sequence: peer.nextOut++, packet, sent: now(), lastTry: -Infinity,
      tries: 0, firstRoute: null };
    peer.outbox.set(flight.sequence, flight);
    transmit(peer, flight, peer.channel?.readyState === 'open' ? 'direct' : 'relay');
    return true;
  }
  function dispatch(peer, packet, route) {
    if (!active() || !Array.isArray(packet) || packet[1] !== peer.session) return;
    peer.lastSeen = now();
    const [kind, , number, payload] = packet;
    if(kind==='v') {
      if(!peer.latest||!Number.isSafeInteger(number)||!Array.isArray(payload)||!['s','u','b'].includes(payload[0])||JSON.stringify(payload).length>8192||number<=(peer.latestIn[payload[0]]||0))return;
      peer.latestIn[payload[0]]=number;
      originalHandle.call(N,{type:'chat',playerId:peer.id,roomId:S.room,message:BASE+JSON.stringify(payload)});
      counters.received++;return;
    }
    if (kind === 'd') {
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(number) || number < 1 || !Array.isArray(payload) ||
        !['s', 'h', 'c', 'u', 'b', 'e', 'g', 'd', 'x', 'p', 'z'].includes(payload[0]) || JSON.stringify(payload).length > 8192) return;
      if (number < peer.nextIn) {
        counters.duplicates++;
        sendControl(peer, ['a', session, number, peer.applied.get(number) || false], route);
        return;
      }
      if (number > peer.nextIn + 127 || peer.inbox.size >= 128) { counters.rejected++; return; }
      if (!peer.inbox.has(number)) peer.inbox.set(number, { payload, route });
      // Preserve application ordering across a direct-to-relay fallback.
      while (peer.inbox.has(peer.nextIn)) {
        const sequence = peer.nextIn++, item = peer.inbox.get(sequence);
        peer.inbox.delete(sequence);
        const before = item.payload[0] === 'h' ? core.report().stats.damageApplied : 0;
        originalHandle.call(N, { type: 'chat', playerId: peer.id, roomId: S.room,
          message: BASE + JSON.stringify(item.payload) });
        const accepted = item.payload[0] === 'h' && core.report().stats.damageApplied > before;
        peer.applied.set(sequence, accepted);
        if (peer.applied.size > 128) peer.applied.delete(peer.applied.keys().next().value);
        counters.received++;
        sendControl(peer, ['a', session, sequence, accepted], item.route);
      }
    } else if (kind === 'a') {
      const flight = peer.outbox.get(number); if (!flight) return;
      peer.outbox.delete(number);
      const elapsed = now() - flight.sent;
      metric(peer, flight.firstRoute + 'AppRttMs', elapsed);
      if (flight.packet[0] === 'h') peer.hitRtt = {
        milliseconds: Math.round(elapsed), path: flight.firstRoute, applied: !!payload };
    } else if (kind === 'p' && typeof number === 'string' && number.length <= 40) {
      sendControl(peer, ['q', session, number], route);
    } else if (kind === 'q') {
      const ping = peer.pings.get(number); if (!ping) return;
      peer.pings.delete(number); metric(peer, ping.route + 'RttMs', now() - ping.sent);
    } else if (route === 'relay' && ['offer', 'answer', 'ice'].includes(kind)) {
      peer.chain = peer.chain.then(() => signal(peer, packet)).catch(error => { peer.lastError = error.message; });
    }
  }
  function receiveSignal(id, packet) {
    if (!active() || !Array.isArray(packet) || packet[1] !== String(S.room) || !S.remotes.has(id)) return;
    if (packet[0] === 'hello') {
      if (!validSession(packet[2]) || packet[3] !== 1) return;
      const peer = makeLink(id, packet[2]); if (!peer) return;
      peer.latest=packet[4]?.latest===true;peer.largeFrames=packet[4]?.largeFrames===true;
      peer.lastSeen = now(); startOffer(peer); return;
    }
    const peer = links.get(id);
    if (!peer || packet[0] !== 'f' || packet[2] !== String(S.id) || packet[3] !== peer.session) return;
    const [, , , , idPart, index, total, text] = packet;
    if (typeof idPart !== 'string' || idPart.length > 16 || !Number.isInteger(index) ||
      !Number.isInteger(total) || total < 1 || total > 384 || index < 0 || index >= total ||
      typeof text !== 'string' || text.length > (peer.largeFrames ? 6000 : 96)) return;
    let assembly = peer.assemblies.get(idPart);
    if (!assembly) {
      if (peer.assemblies.size >= 8) return;
      assembly = { total, parts: new Map(), at: now(), bytes: 0 };
      peer.assemblies.set(idPart, assembly);
    }
    if (assembly.total !== total) return;
    if (!assembly.parts.has(index)) { assembly.parts.set(index, text); assembly.bytes += text.length; }
    if (assembly.bytes > 32768) { peer.assemblies.delete(idPart); return; }
    if (assembly.parts.size === total) {
      peer.assemblies.delete(idPart);
      const text = Array.from({ length: total }, (_, n) => assembly.parts.get(n)).join('');
      try { dispatch(peer, JSON.parse(text), 'relay'); } catch { counters.rejected++; }
    }
  }
  hook(N, 'handle', function(data) {
    syncRoom();
    if (data?.type === 'chat' && typeof data.message === 'string') {
      const id = String(data.playerId || data.senderId || '');
      if (data.message.startsWith(SIGNAL)) {
        if (id && id !== String(S.id) && data.message.length <= 8192) {
          try { receiveSignal(id, JSON.parse(data.message.slice(SIGNAL.length))); }
          catch { counters.rejected++; }
        }
        return;
      }
      // Once upgraded, only ordered envelopes may update this peer's state.
      if (data.message.startsWith(BASE) && links.has(id)) return;
    }
    return originalHandle.call(this, data);
  });
  hook(N, 'send', function(data) {
    syncRoom();
    if (!active() || data?.type !== 'chat' || !data.message?.startsWith(BASE)) return originalSend.call(this, data);
    let packet;
    try { packet = JSON.parse(data.message.slice(BASE.length)); } catch { return originalSend.call(this, data); }
    const ids = packet[0] === 'h' ? [String(packet[3])] : [...S.remotes.keys()].map(String);
    if (!ids.length) return originalSend.call(this, data);
    let unknown = false, accepted = true;
    for (const id of ids) {
      const peer = links.get(id);
      if (peer) accepted = sendApp(peer, packet) && accepted;
      else unknown = true;
    }
    if (unknown) accepted = data.message.length <= 8192 && !!originalSend.call(this, data) && accepted;
    return accepted;
  });
  function removeAI() {
    if (!S.room || !S.confirmedMatch || game.state !== 'playing' || !Array.isArray(game.botMgr?.bots)) return;
    const list = game.botMgr.bots, ai = list.filter(bot => bot && !bot.__connectionsRemote);
    if (!ai.length) return;
    S.originalBots ||= [];
    for (const bot of ai) {
      if (!S.botCtor && typeof bot.constructor === 'function') S.botCtor = bot.constructor;
      if (!S.originalBots.includes(bot)) S.originalBots.push(bot);
      upstream.remoteBots.disableBot?.(bot);
      const index = list.indexOf(bot); if (index >= 0) list.splice(index, 1);
      counters.botsRemoved++;
    }
    game.hud?.buildAvatars?.();
  }
  const badge = null;
  if (badge) {
    badge.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;right:12px;top:12px;z-index:20000;padding:5px 8px;background:#111c;color:#eee;font:12px monospace;pointer-events:none';
    PAGE.document.body?.appendChild(badge);
  }
  function tick() {
    if (stopped) return;
    syncRoom();
    if (now() - lastCleanup > 500) { lastCleanup = now(); removeAI(); }
    if (!active()) { if (badge) badge.textContent = 'Duel: enter TDM and join a room'; return; }
    if (now() - lastHello > 1500) {
      if (relayRaw(['hello', String(S.room), session, 1, {latest:true,largeFrames:true}])) lastHello = now();
    }
    pump();
    for (const [id, peer] of links) {
      if (!S.remotes.has(id)) { closeConnection(peer); links.delete(id); continue; }
      if (peer.pc && peer.channel?.readyState !== 'open' && now() - peer.started > 20000) {
        peer.lastError = 'Direct setup timed out; relay fallback.';
        closeConnection(peer); peer.retryAt = now() + 10000;
      }
      startOffer(peer);
      for (const flight of peer.outbox.values()) {
        const delay = flight.firstRoute === 'direct' && flight.tries === 1 ?
          Math.max(200, (median(peer.metrics.directRttMs) || 50) * 3 + 50) : 1200;
        if (now() - flight.lastTry > delay) {
          // Reliable application retransmission; receiver ordering + dedupe
          // ensures fallback does not apply a hit twice or revive old health.
          if (transmit(peer, flight, 'relay')) counters.retries++;
        }
      }
      for (const [key, assembly] of peer.assemblies) if (now() - assembly.at > 10000) peer.assemblies.delete(key);
      for (const [key, ping] of peer.pings) if (now() - ping.sent > 10000) peer.pings.delete(key);
      if (now() - peer.lastPing > 2000) {
        peer.lastPing = now();
        for (const route of ['relay', ...(peer.channel?.readyState === 'open' ? ['direct'] : [])]) {
          const tag = (++transfer).toString(36) + '-' + route;
          const actual = sendControl(peer, ['p', session, tag], route);
          if (actual) peer.pings.set(tag, { sent: now(), route: actual });
        }
      }
    }
    if (badge && now() - lastBadge > 250) {
      lastBadge = now(); const peer = [...links.values()][0];
      const direct = peer?.channel?.readyState === 'open';
      const latency = peer && median(peer.metrics[direct ? 'directRttMs' : 'relayRttMs']);
      badge.textContent = 'Duel: ' + (direct ? 'direct' : 'relay') + (latency != null ? ' | RTT ' + latency + ' ms' : ' | measuring…');
      badge.style.color = direct ? '#91f5a6' : '#ffd787';
    }
  }
  const timer = PAGE.setInterval(tick, 50);
  const api = {
    version: '2.0.2',
    latency(id) { const peer=links.get(String(id));return peer ? median(peer.metrics[peer.channel?.readyState==='open'?'directRttMs':'relayRttMs']) : null; },
    report() {
      return { version: api.version, enabled: !stopped,
        webRTC: typeof PAGE.RTCPeerConnection === 'function', counters: { ...counters },
        signalingQueue: queue.length,
        peers: [...links.values()].map(peer => ({ id: peer.id,
          transport: peer.channel?.readyState === 'open' ? 'direct' : 'relay',
          connectionState: peer.pc?.connectionState || 'none',
          channelState: peer.channel?.readyState || 'none',
          directRttMs: median(peer.metrics.directRttMs), relayRttMs: median(peer.metrics.relayRttMs),
          latestHit: peer.hitRtt, pendingMessages: peer.outbox.size,
          candidates: peer.candidates, lastError: peer.lastError })) };
    },
    retry() { for (const peer of links.values()) { closeConnection(peer); peer.attempts = 0; peer.retryAt = 0; } },
    stop() {
      if (stopped) return;
      stopped = true; PAGE.clearInterval(timer); closeAll(); badge?.remove?.();
      for (const restore of restores.reverse()) restore();
      delete PAGE.clutcherTeamTransport;
      log('Direct transport stopped.');
    }
  };
  const originalReport = core.report, originalStop = core.stop;
  hook(core, 'report', function() { return { ...originalReport.call(this), direct: api.report() }; });
  hook(core, 'stop', function() { api.stop(); return originalStop.call(this); });
  PAGE.clutcherTeamTransport = api;
  log('Installed for up to ten players.');
  return api;
})(window);

return window.clutcherTeamPlay;
}

  }

  let frameId=0,lastMaintenance=0,lastAura=0;
